title: Tool-Calling LLM Agents Under Realistic MCP Faults: Scale Does Not Purchase Fault Tolerance
title_zh: 真实MCP故障下的工具调用大语言模型智能体：规模并不能换来容错能力

paragraphs.en: LLM agents increasingly rely on external tools exposed via the Model Context Protocol (MCP), yet current benchmarks assume tools respond correctly and on time, leaving agent resilience to realistic tool failures untested. We introduce MCP-Injector, a drop-in, protocol-aware fault-injection middleware that interposes on the MCP tool-call path with controlled persistence (permanent, transient, intermittent) and seedable schedules. Its fault model is calibrated to the observed incident distribution (failure mode × \times persistence) of the public MCP ecosystem, mined from 57,240 issue and pull-request threads across 1,774 open-source MCP repositories. In a 1,350-cell experiment crossing two backbone sizes (20B, 120B), three agent stacks (custom multi-round plan-and-execute, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangChain), and three fault injection conditions, we find that faults drawn from this permanent-heavy stress profile cause severe quality degradation (task-completion score falls by 60%, from 8.08 to 3.23 out of 10), and that scale does not purchase fault tolerance for the two gpt-oss backbones we test: the 120B retains no larger share of its fault-free score under faults (resilience-ratio model, p = 0.96 p=0.96 ), and its completion rate under faults is, if anything, lower (91.1% vs. 95.6%; difference 4.4 points, 95% CI [ − 0.2 , 9.3 ] [-0.2,9.3] ). Agent stacks differ in how well they absorb faults, which suggests that framework-level error handling matters more than model scale. These results demonstrate that capability benchmarks alone can mask operational brittleness, motivating protocol-aware fault injection as a complementary evaluation dimension for tool-calling agents.
paragraphs.zh: LLM智能体日益依赖通过模型上下文协议（MCP）暴露的外部工具，然而现有基准测试假设工具总能正确且及时地响应，使得智能体应对真实工具故障的韧性从未得到检验。 我们提出MCP-Injector，这是一个即插即用、协议感知的故障注入中间件，它以受控的持续性（永久性、瞬时性、间歇性）和可设种的调度方式介入MCP工具调用路径。 其故障模型依据公开MCP生态中观测到的事故分布（故障模式 × 持续性）进行校准，该数据挖掘自1,774个开源MCP仓库中的57,240条议题与拉取请求线程。 在一项跨越两种骨干规模（20B、120B）、三种智能体技术栈（自定义多轮计划-执行、OpenAI Agents SDK、LangChain）以及三种故障注入条件的1,350单元实验中，我们发现取自这种永久性为主的压力特征的故障会导致严重的质量下降（任务完成得分从10分制的8.08降至3.23，下降60%），并且对于我们所测试的两个gpt-oss骨干而言，规模并不能换来容错能力：在故障下，120B模型保留其无故障得分的比例并不更大（韧性比模型，p = 0.96），其在故障下的完成率甚至更低（91.1%对95.6%；差值4.4个百分点，95%置信区间[−0.2, 9.3]）。 不同智能体技术栈吸收故障的能力存在差异，这表明框架层面的错误处理比模型规模更为重要。 这些结果表明，仅凭能力基准测试可能掩盖运行层面的脆弱性，这促使我们将协议感知的故障注入作为工具调用智能体评估的一个补充维度。

paragraphs.en: LLM agents increasingly act through external tools [ 8 , 18 ] exposed via the Model Context Protocol (MCP), a vendor-neutral, structured client-server interface for tool invocation [ 6 , 26 , 7 ] . This makes agent quality a system question: end-to-end behavior depends on the MCP channel, server implementations, schemas, and the operational health of the tool ecosystem. In production, MCP-facing agents inherit failure modes familiar from distributed services [ 1 , 3 ] , yet current benchmarks evaluate agents assuming tools respond correctly and on time [ 31 , 27 , 28 , 19 ] . Without protocol-aware fault injection, the community lacks a controlled method to answer: Which agent designs degrade gracefully? Does scaling the backbone reduce or increase operational brittleness?
paragraphs.zh: LLM 智能体越来越多地通过外部工具 [8, 18] 行动，这些工具经由模型上下文协议（MCP）暴露，MCP 是一个厂商中立的、结构化的客户端-服务器工具调用接口 [6, 26, 7]。 这使得智能体质量成为一个系统性问题：端到端行为取决于 MCP 通道、服务器实现、模式（schema）以及工具生态系统的运行健康状况。 在生产环境中，面向 MCP 的智能体继承了分布式服务中常见的故障模式 [1, 3]，然而当前的基准测试在评估智能体时假定工具总能正确且及时地响应 [31, 27, 28, 19]。 在缺乏协议感知故障注入的情况下，社区缺少一种受控方法来回答：哪些智能体设计能够优雅降级？ 扩大骨干模型的规模会降低还是增加运维上的脆弱性？

paragraphs.en: Because MCP standardizes structured tool calls, failures can be semantic: a well-formed but wrong value, a schema violation, a silent hang, or a retry cascade. These behaviors align with classic content and timing failure classes [ 1 ] but must be expressed at the MCP interface to exercise agent logic that interprets outputs, retries, and composes answers. Infrastructure-level chaos engineering [ 2 ] operates below this semantic layer, and benchmarks do not control fault persistence or provide calibrated profiles, leaving a gap for benchmark-compatible, MCP-semantic fault injection. We introduce MCP-Injector, a drop-in middleware that interposes on the MCP client-server path and injects faults with controlled persistence (permanent, transient, intermittent), with a fault model calibrated to the observed incident distribution of the public MCP ecosystem (57,240 issue and pull-request threads across 1,774 open-source MCP repositories) and packaged as a seedable injection schedule applicable to any MCP-based agent without modifying the agent or the tools.
paragraphs.zh: 由于 MCP 将结构化工具调用标准化，故障可以是语义层面的：一个格式良好但错误的值、违反模式（schema）、静默挂起，或重试级联。 这些行为与经典的内容类和时序类故障相吻合 [ 1 ]，但必须在 MCP 接口处表达，才能锻炼智能体中解释输出、执行重试并组合答案的逻辑。 基础设施层的混沌工程 [ 2 ] 在该语义层之下运作，而现有基准测试既不控制故障的持续性，也不提供经过校准的故障画像，这为兼容基准测试、具备 MCP 语义的故障注入留下了空白。 我们提出 MCP-Injector，一种即插即用的中间件，它在 MCP 客户端-服务器路径上进行拦截，并注入具有受控持续性的故障（永久性、瞬时性、间歇性）；其故障模型依据对公共 MCP 生态系统（涵盖 1,774 个开源 MCP 仓库中的 57,240 条议题与拉取请求线程）所观察到的故障分布进行校准，并被封装为可播种的注入计划，可应用于任何基于 MCP 的智能体，而无需修改该智能体或工具。

paragraphs.en: Contributions. (1) An MCP fault model calibrated to the observed incident distribution (mode × \times persistence) of the public MCP ecosystem, mined from 57,240 threads across 1,774 open-source repositories, so that the mix of injected faults follows reported incidents rather than hand-crafted scenarios. (2) A 1,350-cell full-factorial study (three stacks, two backbone scales, three fault conditions, 25 tasks, three seeds) showing that scale does not purchase fault tolerance for the two gpt-oss backbones tested (the larger backbone retains no larger share of its fault-free score under calibrated faults and completes descriptively fewer tasks) and suggestive evidence that framework-level error handling matters more than model scale. (3) MCP-Injector itself, a reproducible, stack-agnostic, drop-in middleware released with full artifacts.
paragraphs.zh: 贡献。 （1）一个针对公开 MCP 生态中观察到的故障分布（故障模式 × \times 持续性）进行校准的 MCP 故障模型，该分布从 1,774 个开源仓库的 57,240 个会话线程中挖掘得出，从而使注入故障的组合遵循已报告的事故，而非手工构造的场景。 （2）一项包含 1,350 个单元格的全因子研究（三个技术栈、两种骨干模型规模、三种故障条件、25 个任务、三个随机种子），其结果表明，对于所测试的两个 gpt-oss 骨干模型，更大的规模并不能带来更强的容错能力（在经过校准的故障下，较大的骨干模型所保留的无故障分数比例并不更高，且直观上完成的任务数量更少），并提供提示性证据表明，框架层面的错误处理比模型规模更为重要。 （3）MCP-Injector 本身，一个可复现、与技术栈无关、即插即用的中间件，并随附完整的制品发布。

paragraphs.en: Tool-using LLM agents are implemented as an MCP client embedded in an agent runtime, connected to one or more MCP servers that expose executable tools . We treat the tool-call exchange (the structured invocation request and its result or error) as the key service interface and call it the MCP tool-call boundary . Our experiments and injector operate strictly at this boundary; other MCP capabilities (prompts, resources, streaming) are out of scope, since tool calls are the dominant actuator by which agents affect the external world. We adopt a non-adversarial threat model : injected faults represent commonplace production problems (misconfiguration, transient unavailability, schema drift, malformed outputs), not an intelligent attacker; security attacks, model-internal faults, and unrelated application-layer issues are excluded.
paragraphs.zh: 使用工具的大语言模型智能体被实现为嵌入在智能体运行时中的 MCP 客户端，并连接到一个或多个暴露可执行工具的 MCP 服务器。 我们将工具调用交互（结构化的调用请求及其结果或错误）视为关键服务接口，并将其称为 MCP 工具调用边界。 我们的实验和故障注入器严格在这一边界上进行操作；其他 MCP 能力（提示、资源、流式传输）不在范围之内，因为工具调用是智能体影响外部世界的主要执行手段。 我们采用非对抗性威胁模型：注入的故障代表生产环境中常见的问题（配置错误、暂时不可用、模式漂移、格式错误的输出），而非智能攻击者；安全攻击、模型内部故障以及无关的应用层问题均被排除在外。

paragraphs.en: We use standard dependability terminology [ 1 ] instantiated at the MCP tool-call boundary. A service failure is a deviation of observed tool-call behavior from what the client expects (e.g., an error instead of a result, excessive latency, a schema-violating result); a fault is its underlying cause (a buggy implementation, misconfiguration, or dependency outage). Because systems compose, a failure of the MCP server is an external fault from the client’s perspective. Our injector injects such external faults at the interface between the agent and the MCP server, rather than within server internals, for more controlled and efficient experiments as typical of fault injection studies [ 20 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用标准的可信性术语 [ 1 ] ，并将其实例化到 MCP 工具调用边界。 服务失效是指观察到的工具调用行为偏离客户端的预期（例如，返回错误而非结果、延迟过高、结果违反模式）；而故障是其根本原因（有缺陷的实现、错误配置或依赖服务中断）。 由于系统是组合而成的，MCP 服务器的失效从客户端的角度来看是一种外部故障。 我们的故障注入器在智能体与 MCP 服务器之间的接口处注入此类外部故障，而不是在服务器内部，以便进行更可控、更高效的实验，这也符合故障注入研究的典型做法 [ 20 ] 。

sents.en: We use standard dependability terminology [ 1 ] instantiated at the MCP tool-call boundary.
sents.zh: 我们使用标准的可信性术语 [ 1 ] ，并将其实例化到 MCP 工具调用边界。

sents.zh: 服务失效是指观察到的工具调用行为偏离客户端的预期（例如，返回错误而非结果、延迟过高、结果违反模式）；而故障是其根本原因（有缺陷的实现、错误配置或依赖服务中断）。

sents.en: Because systems compose, a failure of the MCP server is an external fault from the client’s perspective.
sents.zh: 由于系统是组合而成的，MCP 服务器的失效从客户端的角度来看是一种外部故障。

sents.en: Our injector injects such external faults at the interface between the agent and the MCP server, rather than within server internals, for more controlled and efficient experiments as typical of fault injection studies [ 20 ] .
sents.zh: 我们的故障注入器在智能体与 MCP 服务器之间的接口处注入此类外部故障，而不是在服务器内部，以便进行更可控、更高效的实验，这也符合故障注入研究的典型做法 [ 20 ] 。

paragraphs.en: At the MCP boundary, interface failures divide into two classes [ 1 ] : timing failures (results not delivered within the expected time budget, excessively delayed, or never delivered) and content failures (results that arrive but are wrong or unusable: incorrect values, malformed payloads, schema/type violations). Beyond what fails, dependability evaluation must model how failures evolve. We treat persistence as the central temporal dimension: permanent failures recur on every invocation until external corrective action; transient failures are short-lived and resolve without intervention; intermittent failures alternate between faulty and correct behavior in temporally correlated bursts. Our injector operationalizes these persistence modes as injection schedules over the tool-call boundary.
paragraphs.zh: 在 MCP 边界处，接口失效分为两类 [ 1 ]：时序失效（结果未在预期时间预算内送达、送达严重延迟或从未送达）和内容失效（结果虽已送达但错误或不可用：数值不正确、载荷格式错误、模式/类型违规）。 除了失效本身之外，可靠性评估还必须对失效如何演化进行建模。 我们将持续性视为核心的时间维度：永久性失效在每次调用中反复出现，直到采取外部纠正措施；瞬时失效持续时间短暂且无需干预即可自行消除；间歇性失效在时间上相关的突发中交替呈现错误与正确行为。 我们的注入器将这些持续性模式实现为针对工具调用边界的注入调度。

paragraphs.en: MCP-Injector 1 1 1 Artifact (code, data, analysis pipeline): https://gitlab.com/uniluxembourg/snt/sedan/papers/mcp-injector , archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23573765 . is a protocol-aware fault-injection middleware for tool-calling LLM agents that communicate over MCP. It is drop-in (no modifications to the agent runtime, MCP client, or servers), reproducible (seeded injection schedules), low-interference (minimal perturbation when faults are disabled), and stack-agnostic .
paragraphs.zh: MCP-Injector¹¹¹ 工件（代码、数据、分析流水线）：https://gitlab.com/uniluxembourg/snt/sedan/papers/mcp-injector，已归档于 https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23573765。是一款面向通过 MCP 通信的工具调用型 LLM 智能体的协议感知故障注入中间件。 它是即插即用的（无需修改智能体运行时、MCP 客户端或服务器）、可复现的（带种子的注入计划）、低干扰的（禁用故障时扰动极小），且与技术栈无关。

sents.en: It is drop-in (no modifications to the agent runtime, MCP client, or servers), reproducible (seeded injection schedules), low-interference (minimal perturbation when faults are disabled), and stack-agnostic .
sents.zh: 它是即插即用的（无需修改智能体运行时、MCP 客户端或服务器）、可复现的（带种子的注入计划）、低干扰的（禁用故障时扰动极小），且与技术栈无关。

paragraphs.en: MCP-Injector is implemented as proxy-style middleware on the tool-invocation path (Figure 1 ). It intercepts the call_tool hook exposed by MCP client libraries, acting as an MCP server toward the upstream agent and as an MCP client toward the downstream real server(s), and can be toggled on or off via a single configuration flag. Request-side interception handles timing faults (delays, silent drops) and explicit errors that can be synthesized without contacting the server; response-side interception handles content faults by mutating the real server’s output before it reaches the agent.
paragraphs.zh: MCP-Injector 在工具调用路径上以代理式中间件的形式实现（图 1）。 它拦截 MCP 客户端库暴露的 call_tool 钩子，对上游智能体充当 MCP 服务器，对下游真实服务器充当 MCP 客户端，并且可以通过单个配置开关启用或禁用。 请求侧拦截处理时序故障（延迟、静默丢弃）以及无需联系服务器即可合成的显式错误；响应侧拦截通过在真实服务器的输出到达智能体之前对其进行篡改来处理内容故障。

sents.en: MCP-Injector is implemented as proxy-style middleware on the tool-invocation path (Figure 1 ).
sents.zh: MCP-Injector 在工具调用路径上以代理式中间件的形式实现（图 1）。

sents.en: It intercepts the call_tool hook exposed by MCP client libraries, acting as an MCP server toward the upstream agent and as an MCP client toward the downstream real server(s), and can be toggled on or off via a single configuration flag.

paragraphs.en: MCP-Injector exposes faults through a configuration-driven API that separates three orthogonal concerns: what failure to emulate (operator), how long it persists (schedule), and where it applies (scope).
paragraphs.zh: MCP-Injector 通过一个配置驱动的 API 来暴露故障，该 API 将三个正交的关注点分离：模拟什么故障（operator）、持续多长时间（schedule），以及应用于何处（scope）。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 lists the six fault operators plus one passthrough, each corresponding to an empirically observed MCP failure mode (Section 4 ). Operators either short-circuit the request (explicit error, silent drop), delay forwarding, or mutate the response content.
paragraphs.zh: 表1列出了六种故障算子外加一个直通算子，每种对应一种经实证观察到的 MCP 失效模式（见第4节）。 算子要么短路请求（显式报错、静默丢弃），要么延迟转发，要么篡改响应内容。

sents.en: Table 1 lists the six fault operators plus one passthrough, each corresponding to an empirically observed MCP failure mode (Section 4 ).
sents.zh: 表1列出了六种故障算子外加一个直通算子，每种对应一种经实证观察到的 MCP 失效模式（见第4节）。

sents.en: Operators either short-circuit the request (explicit error, silent drop), delay forwarding, or mutate the response content.
sents.zh: 算子要么短路请求（显式报错、静默丢弃），要么延迟转发，要么篡改响应内容。

paragraphs.en: MCP-Injector realizes the three persistence regimes of Section 2 as seeded schedules: Permanent fires on every subsequent matching call once activated, Transient fires on a single call with a configured activation probability and then resets, and Intermittent holds the drawn entry for a random number of calls (released with a per-call deactivation probability) and fires on each held call with an activation probability.
paragraphs.zh: MCP-Injector 将第 2 节中的三种持久化机制实现为预设的调度方式：Permanent（永久型）在激活后于每次后续匹配调用时触发；Transient（瞬态型）在单次调用中按配置的激活概率触发一次，随后重置；Intermittent（间歇型）将抽中的条目保持随机次数的调用（每次调用以一定概率解除激活），并在每次保持的调用上按激活概率触发。

paragraphs.en: A fault profile may combine multiple (operator, persistence) entries with configured selection weights, which MCP-Injector samples to produce realistic failure mixtures under seeded fault schedules: injection decisions are drawn from a seeded pseudo-random stream, so they are deterministic given the seed and the agent’s tool-call history, and every fired fault is logged. End-to-end runs are not bit-reproducible, because local serving and the judge are stochastic (Appendix A ).
paragraphs.zh: 故障配置文件（fault profile）可以将多个（操作符，持久化）条目与配置的选择权重组合起来，MCP-Injector 会在种子化故障调度下对这些条目进行采样，以产生真实的故障混合：注入决策从种子化伪随机流中抽取，因此在给定种子和智能体的工具调用历史的情况下，它们是确定性的，并且每个触发的故障都会被记录。 端到端运行不是比特级可复现的，因为本地服务和评判（judge）是随机的（附录 A）。

paragraphs.en: We derive a fault profile, calibrated to the observed incident distribution of the public MCP ecosystem, that specifies what MCP-visible failure manifestations to inject and how they evolve over time. Rather than relying on ad hoc assumptions, we mine public MCP tool-server repositories and classify observed incidents using standard dependability terminology [ 1 ] , specialized to the MCP tool-call boundary (Section 2 ). Figure 2 summarizes the six-stage pipeline.
paragraphs.zh: 我们推导出一个故障画像，其以公开 MCP 生态系统中观察到的事件分布为校准依据，规定了应注入哪些 MCP 可见的故障表现，以及这些故障表现如何随时间演变。 我们不依赖临时假设，而是挖掘公开的 MCP 工具服务器仓库，并使用标准可靠性术语 [1] 对观察到的事件进行分类，该术语专门针对 MCP 工具调用边界（第 2 节）。 图 2 总结了这一六阶段流水线。

sents.zh: 图 2 总结了这一六阶段流水线。

paragraphs.en: Within the content and timing classes of Section 2 , we distinguish six mutually exclusive failure modes . Content failures: minor mistake (small deviation, structurally valid), incorrect output (semantically wrong, structurally valid), invalid output (schema/type violation), and explicit error (structured error in place of a result). Timing failures: delayed response and silent drop . Together with the three persistence regimes of Section 2 , these modes define the (mode, persistence) target space for calibration.
paragraphs.zh: 在第2节的内容类和时间类中，我们区分出六种互斥的失效模式。 内容失效包括：轻微错误（小幅偏差，结构有效）、错误输出（语义错误，结构有效）、无效输出（违反模式/类型）以及显式错误（以结构化错误代替结果）。 时间失效包括：响应延迟和静默丢弃。 结合第2节的三种持久化机制，这些模式定义了用于校准的（失效模式，持久化）目标空间。

paragraphs.en: We assembled 1,774 active public MCP tool-server repositories (collected September 2025) by combining two public registries, MCP Market 2 2 2 https://mcpmarket.com/server and Awesome MCP Servers 3 3 3 https://github.com/punkpeye/awesome-mcp-servers , deduplicating, and removing inaccessible ones. For each repository we mined up to 200 recent issues and pull requests via the GitHub REST API (103k issues; 64k PRs; 158k comments; 258k commits; 71k reviews; 65k review comments) and constructed per-thread narratives by concatenating all artifacts in chronological order, truncating threads above 50k characters to prioritize early failure descriptions. This stage yielded 103,166 consolidated threads.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过合并两个公共注册表（MCP Market 2 2 2 https://mcpmarket.com/server 和 Awesome MCP Servers 3 3 3 https://github.com/punkpeye/awesome-mcp-servers），去重并移除无法访问的仓库，最终汇总了 1,774 个活跃的公共 MCP 工具服务器仓库（收集于 2025 年 9 月）。 对于每个仓库，我们通过 GitHub REST API 挖掘了最多 200 条近期 issue 和拉取请求（103k 条 issue；64k 个拉取请求；158k 条评论；258k 次提交；71k 条评审；65k 条评审评论），并通过按时间顺序拼接所有工件来构建每个会话线程的叙述，对超过 5 万字符的线程进行截断，以优先保留早期的失败描述。 该阶段共产生 103,166 个合并后的线程。

paragraphs.en: A keyword-based heuristic partitioned threads into failures, non-failures, and uncertain cases following prior issue-mining work [ 24 ] . After removing 1,374 cross-link duplicates, excluding build-related threads (3,013) and non-English threads (2,668) across automated and manual passes, the analysis set contained 57,240 English-language classified threads.
paragraphs.zh: 基于关键词的启发式方法按照先前的问题挖掘工作 [ 24 ] 将讨论串划分为失败、非失败和不确定三类。 在通过自动化与人工多轮处理移除 1,374 个交叉链接重复项、排除与构建相关的讨论串（3,013 个）以及非英语讨论串（2,668 个）后，分析集包含 57,240 个已分类的英语讨论串。

paragraphs.en: We used gpt-4o-2024-08-06 (temperature 0, fixed JSON schema, ∼ \sim $800 in API cost) to classify each thread into (failure mode, persistence) pairs and extract mode-specific parameters (error subtypes, data-type patterns, delay magnitudes). To assess reliability, two senior researchers independently annotated a stratified sample of 117 threads (five per non-empty stratum) with a third adjudicating disagreements; agreement was high (Cohen’s κ = 0.93 \kappa=0.93 for failure mode, 0.80 0.80 for persistence [ 14 ] ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 gpt-4o-2024-08-06（temperature 0，固定 JSON schema，约 800 美元 API 费用）将每个帖子线程分类为（失效模式，持续性）对，并提取模式特定的参数（错误子类型、数据类型模式、延迟幅度）。 为评估可靠性，两名资深研究者独立对一个分层样本 117 个帖子线程（每个非空层 5 个）进行标注，第三人仲裁分歧；一致性很高（失效模式的 Cohen's κ = 0.93，持续性为 0.80 [14]）。

paragraphs.en: Aggregating classifier outputs yields the empirical distribution in Table 2 . Permanent failures predominate, with explicit_error the largest share (10,393 of 14,829 classified failures); other content failures ( invalid_output , incorrect_output , minor_mistake ) are less frequent but operationally significant due to silent propagation risk; timing failures ( delayed_response , silent_drop ) span permanent and intermittent persistence. We package these distributions as a versioned, seedable fault profile consumed by MCP-Injector (Section 3 ).

paragraphs.en: We evaluate on MCP-Bench [ 28 ] , a multi-step tool-use benchmark with rubric-based LLM-as-a-judge scoring. Using its task-generation pipeline, we produced 25 single-server tasks from 25 successfully connected MCP servers (out of 28 attempted), each exposing multiple tools. Tasks are presented to agents as fuzzy (naturalistic, underspecified) user prompts; the original concrete descriptions serve only as evaluation references. Distraction servers are disabled ( --distraction-count 0 ) to isolate tool-call faults from irrelevant conversational noise.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 MCP-Bench [ 28 ] 上进行评估，这是一个多步骤工具使用基准，采用基于评分细则的 LLM 作为裁判的打分方式。 利用其任务生成流程，我们从 25 个成功连接的 MCP 服务器（共尝试 28 个）中构建了 25 个单服务器任务，每个服务器都提供多个工具。 任务以模糊（自然、欠明确的）用户提示的形式呈现给智能体；原始的具体描述仅作为评估参考。 干扰服务器已被禁用（ --distraction-count 0 ），以便将工具调用故障与无关的对话噪声隔离开来。

paragraphs.en: Two locally hosted open-weight models, gpt-oss-20B and gpt-oss-120B , served at their released MXFP4 precision with a fixed 16,000-token context window and default decoding parameters on consumer Apple Silicon via LM Studio (full hardware and serving configuration in Appendix I ). No per-model prompt tuning is applied; differences are attributable to model scale alone.

paragraphs.en: Three orchestration frameworks connect to the same MCP tool interface: (i) a multi-round plan-and-execute loop from MCP-Bench [ 28 ] ; (ii) an OpenAI Agents SDK agent [ 21 ] ; (iii) a LangChain/LangGraph pre-built agent [ 15 ] . Task prompts, tool schemas, context budget, and the per-task timeout/stopping policy are held constant across stacks; only intrinsic orchestration behavior (planning, retry logic, intermediate reasoning format) is allowed to vary. Appendix F documents these differences in detail.
paragraphs.zh: 三种编排框架连接到同一个 MCP 工具接口：(i) 来自 MCP-Bench [28] 的多轮计划-执行循环；(ii) 一个 OpenAI Agents SDK 智能体 [21]；(iii) 一个 LangChain/LangGraph 预构建智能体 [15]。 任务提示、工具模式（schema）、上下文预算以及每任务的超时/停止策略在各技术栈间保持不变；仅允许内在编排行为（规划、重试逻辑、中间推理格式）有所差异。 附录 F 详细记录了这些差异。

sents.en: Appendix F documents these differences in detail.
sents.zh: 附录 F 详细记录了这些差异。

paragraphs.en: Each task runs under three proxy conditions: (i) Proxy-off : no interposition (true baseline); (ii) OP0 : proxy with a null pass-through operator (exercises integration overhead); (iii) OPP : proxy with the 18-rule calibrated fault profile from Section 4 (derivation in Appendix A ). Robustness comparisons use a paired within-task design: for every (task, seed) tuple we compute per-metric degradation Δ = OPP − OP0 \Delta=\text{OPP}-\text{OP0} . Three seeds per condition (fixing benchmark, injector, and framework RNG seeds) yield 2 × 3 × 3 × 3 × 25 = 1,350 2\times 3\times 3\times 3\times 25=\mathbf{1{,}350} experimental cells.
paragraphs.zh: 每个任务在三种代理条件下运行：(i) Proxy-off：无介入（真实基线）；(ii) OP0：带有空透传算子的代理（用于检验集成开销）；(iii) OPP：带有第 4 节中 18 条规则校准故障配置的代理（推导见附录 A）。 鲁棒性比较采用任务内配对设计：对每个（任务，种子）组合，我们计算每个指标的退化量 Δ = OPP − OP0 \Delta=\text{OPP}-\text{OP0}。 每个条件下三个种子（固定基准、注入器和框架的 RNG 种子）共产生 2 × 3 × 3 × 3 × 25 = 1,350 2\times 3\times 3\times 3\times 25=\mathbf{1{,}350} 个实验单元。

paragraphs.en: All 1,350 reported cells are governed by a single run policy: a 3,000 s per-task wall-clock timeout and a loop bound of 40 rounds (MCPBench max_execution_rounds ), 40 turns (OpenAI max_turns ), or 25 supersteps (LangChain, LangGraph default; Appendix F ), which prevents unbounded hangs under silent-drop and delay faults. All OPP cells and every reported non-completion ran under these limits; fault-free cells that completed in earlier campaign rounds ran under tighter limits that they never reached (Appendix I ), so the campaign history cannot inflate any reported non-completion. A run terminated by the timeout, by loop-bound exhaustion, or by an unhandled tool exception is classified as a system-level failure . The LLM-as-a-judge evaluator (gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18 model) scores each completed run five times with a randomized rubric order to mitigate judge instability; we report median scores. Aggregate compute for the final 1,350 reported cells was approximately 58 wall-clock hours of agent execution plus about 18 hours of LLM-as-a-judge API time; the full five-round campaign history is in Appendix I .
paragraphs.zh: 所有 1,350 个报告单元格均受统一的运行策略约束：每任务 3,000 秒的墙钟超时，以及循环上限 40 轮（MCPBench 的 max_execution_rounds）、40 个回合（OpenAI 的 max_turns）或 25 个超级步（LangChain、LangGraph 默认值；附录 F），以防止在静默丢包和延迟故障下出现无界的挂起。 所有 OPP 单元格以及每一个报告的未完成运行都在这些限制内执行；在更早活动轮次中已完成的无故障单元格则在更紧的限制下运行且从未触及该限制（附录 I），因此活动历史不会夸大任何报告的未完成。 因超时、循环上限耗尽或未处理的工具异常而终止的运行被归类为系统级失败。 LLM 作为评判者的评估器（gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18 模型）以随机化的评分标准顺序对每次已完成的运行评分五次，以缓解评判者的不稳定性；我们报告中位数分数。 最终 1,350 个报告单元格的总计算量约为 58 墙钟小时的智能体执行时间，外加约 18 小时的 LLM 作为评判者的 API 时间；完整的五轮活动历史见附录 I。

paragraphs.en: We report three metric families. (i) Task-quality scores : MCP-Bench’s rubric-based judge rates task fulfillment, grounding, tool appropriateness, and parameter accuracy, enabling analysis beyond binary task completion. (ii) System-level outcomes : timeout and unhandled-error indicators, reported as failure rates per condition. (iii) Latency decomposition : end-to-end, agent-internal (LLM, planning, orchestration), and evaluation time, supporting both intrusiveness analysis under OP0 and fault-amplification analysis under OPP.
paragraphs.zh: 我们报告三类指标。 (i) 任务质量得分：MCP-Bench 基于评分准则的评判器对任务完成度、依据准确性、工具选择合理性和参数准确性进行评分，使分析得以超越二元的任务完成判定。 (ii) 系统级结果：超时和未处理错误指标，以每种条件下的失败率形式报告。 (iii) 延迟分解：端到端、智能体内部（LLM、规划、编排）以及评估时间，既支持 OP0 条件下的侵入性分析，也支持 OPP 条件下的故障放大分析。

paragraphs.en: We report three primary findings: calibrated MCP faults cause severe, pervasive quality degradation (Section 6.1 ); framework-level error handling plausibly matters more than model scale (suggestive evidence; Section 6.2 ); and scale does not purchase fault tolerance (Section 6.3 ). Two apparatus-validation checks precondition these findings: proxy non-intrusiveness (paired Wilcoxon, all Bonferroni-corrected p ≥ 0.05 p\geq 0.05 over 18 tests; Appendix B ) and injection fidelity (the per-run fault draw follows the profile, and cells exposed to at least one fault degrade far more than unexposed cells; Appendix C ). Mechanistic and task-level complements appear in Appendices D , G , and H .
paragraphs.zh: 我们报告三项主要发现：经过校准的 MCP 故障会造成严重且普遍的质量退化（第 6.1 节）；框架层面的错误处理可能比模型规模更重要（提示性证据；第 6.2 节）；且规模并不能换来容错能力（第 6.3 节）。 两项装置有效性验证检查是这些发现的前提：代理的非侵入性（配对 Wilcoxon 检验，18 项测试的 Bonferroni 校正后 p ≥ 0.05 p\geq 0.05；附录 B）以及注入保真度（每次运行的故障抽取遵循该分布，且暴露于至少一个故障的单元格的退化程度远高于未暴露的单元格；附录 C）。 机制层面与任务层面的补充内容见附录 D、G 和 H。

sents.en: We report three primary findings: calibrated MCP faults cause severe, pervasive quality degradation (Section 6.1 ); framework-level error handling plausibly matters more than model scale (suggestive evidence; Section 6.2 ); and scale does not purchase fault tolerance (Section 6.3 ).
sents.zh: 我们报告三项主要发现：经过校准的 MCP 故障会造成严重且普遍的质量退化（第 6.1 节）；框架层面的错误处理可能比模型规模更重要（提示性证据；第 6.2 节）；且规模并不能换来容错能力（第 6.3 节）。

sents.en: Two apparatus-validation checks precondition these findings: proxy non-intrusiveness (paired Wilcoxon, all Bonferroni-corrected p ≥ 0.05 p\geq 0.05 over 18 tests; Appendix B ) and injection fidelity (the per-run fault draw follows the profile, and cells exposed to at least one fault degrade far more than unexposed cells; Appendix C ).
sents.zh: 两项装置有效性验证检查是这些发现的前提：代理的非侵入性（配对 Wilcoxon 检验，18 项测试的 Bonferroni 校正后 p ≥ 0.05 p\geq 0.05；附录 B）以及注入保真度（每次运行的故障抽取遵循该分布，且暴露于至少一个故障的单元格的退化程度远高于未暴露的单元格；附录 C）。

sents.en: Mechanistic and task-level complements appear in Appendices D , G , and H .
sents.zh: 机制层面与任务层面的补充内容见附录 D、G 和 H。

paragraphs.en: We analyze 450 OPP cells (25 tasks × \times 3 seeds × \times 3 stacks × \times 2 models) paired against their OP0 counterparts. Cells that timed out or errored under OPP receive 0 in the primary analysis; a completed-only secondary analysis is reported alongside.
paragraphs.zh: 我们分析了 450 个 OPP 单元格（25 个任务 × 3 个随机种子 × 3 个技术栈 × 2 个模型），并将它们与对应的 OP0 单元格进行配对比较。 在主要分析中，在 OPP 下超时或出错的单元格记为 0 分；同时我们还报告了仅计完成情况（completed-only）的次要分析结果。

paragraphs.en: Under OP0, completion rates sit between 95 and 100% across all (stack, model) combinations (proxy-off baselines 93 to 100%). Under OPP, they fall to 88 to 97%, with the largest declines in OpenAI/120b (88%) and MCPBench/120b (91%). The 120b completes fewer tasks than the 20b in every stack (pooled 91.1% vs. 95.6%), a descriptive gap examined in Section 6.3 ; full per-cell rates appear in Appendix D (Table 4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在 OP0 下，所有（技术栈，模型）组合的完成率都在 95% 到 100% 之间（关闭代理的基线为 93% 到 100%）。 在 OPP 下，完成率降至 88% 到 97%，其中 OpenAI/120b（88%）和 MCPBench/120b（91%）降幅最大。 在所有技术栈中，120b 完成的任务都少于 20b（汇总为 91.1% 对 95.6%），这一描述性差距将在 6.3 节中讨论；每个单元格的完整完成率见附录 D（表 4）。

paragraphs.en: Pooled across all stacks and models, degradation is severe: task completion score drops 60% (8.08 to 3.23), tool selection 59%, planning effectiveness 67%, and the remaining six metrics 54 to 68% (full breakdown in Appendix D , Table 5 ). Every metric drops by 4.4 to 5.2 points out of 10 (paired 95% CIs within ± 0.4 \pm 0.4 points; rank-biserial r ≈ 0.9 r\approx 0.9 ; Benjamini-Hochberg corrected Wilcoxon p < 0.001 p<0.001 ). Restricted to cells that completed under both conditions, the pattern persists (57% drop in task completion), so degradation reflects genuine quality loss among successful runs and not only non-completion.
paragraphs.zh: 汇总所有技术栈与模型，性能退化非常严重：任务完成得分下降 60%（8.08 降至 3.23），工具选择下降 59%，规划有效性下降 67%，其余六项指标下降 54% 至 68%（完整分解见附录 D，表 5）。 每项指标均下降 4.4 至 5.2 分（满分 10 分）（配对 95% 置信区间在 ± 0.4 \pm 0.4 分以内；秩双列相关 r ≈ 0.9 r\approx 0.9；经 Benjamini-Hochberg 校正的 Wilcoxon 检验 p < 0.001 p<0.001）。 仅限于在两种条件下均完成的样本单元时，该模式依然存在（任务完成率下降 57%），因此性能退化反映了成功运行中的真实质量损失，而不仅是未完成的情况。

paragraphs.en: Figure 3 classifies all 450 OPP cells into six behavioral categories. Partial degradation is the most common outcome (56% of cells; 44 to 71% across stack and model): agents typically complete tasks but with substantially reduced quality. Unaffected cells account for 7 to 19% per stack and model. The remaining 21 to 39% split across catastrophic completion, graceful degradation, tool bypass, and non-completion. Annotated case studies for each category appear in Appendix E .
paragraphs.zh: 图 3 将全部 450 个 OPP 单元划分为六种行为类别。 部分退化是最常见的结果（占单元的 56%；在不同技术栈与模型之间为 44% 至 71%）：智能体通常能完成任务，但质量明显下降。 未受影响的单元在每个技术栈与模型中占 7% 至 19%。 其余 21% 至 39% 分布在灾难性完成、优雅退化、工具绕过和未完成这几种情况中。 每个类别的注释案例研究见附录 E。

paragraphs.en: A completed run counts as tool bypass when the judge rates task fulfillment at least 4 but tool appropriateness below 2: a plausible answer without tool evidence. Under OPP this covers 27 cells (6.0%): 14 of 150 for LangChain, 9 for OpenAI, and 4 for MCPBench. Faults are not the main cause. The same rule flags 21 OP0 and 16 Proxy-off cells, the LangChain and MCPBench counts are identical with and without faults, and only OpenAI rises (3 to 9 cells; paired exact McNemar p = 0.07 p=0.07 ). Bypass also explains much of the zero-dose set: 17 of the 27 bypass cells made no tool call, so no fault could fire, and they are 17 of the 55 zero-dose OPP cells (12.2%); excluding zero-dose cells raises the task-completion drop from 60% to 67%. These runs score well despite ungrounded answers. A LangChain/120b run of unit_converter_000 computed every conversion from memory and scored 9.8 on task fulfillment and 9.3 on task completion, but 1.2 on tool appropriateness. Such answers inflate scores under faults while hiding what a deployment would care about, so we also report a grounded-fulfillment view that counts task fulfillment only when tool appropriateness is at least 2. Under OPP, runs below that threshold supply 16% of all fulfillment credit (OP0: 5%), so grounded fulfillment falls by 63% rather than 58% (paired drop − 4.87 -4.87 points, 95% CI [ − 5.27 , − 4.47 ] [-5.27,-4.47] ; OpenAI: 68% vs. 61%; Table 5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 当评审者给任务达成度打分不低于 4 但工具恰当性低于 2 时，该完成的运行即计为工具绕过：即没有工具证据的看似合理的答案。 在 OPP 下这涵盖 27 个单元格（6.0%）：150 个中 LangChain 占 14 个，OpenAI 占 9 个，MCPBench 占 4 个。 故障并不是主要原因。 同一规则还标出 21 个 OP0 和 16 个 Proxy 关闭的单元格，LangChain 和 MCPBench 的计数在有故障和无故障时完全相同，只有 OpenAI 上升（从 3 个到 9 个单元格；配对精确 McNemar p = 0.07 p=0.07 ）。 绕过也解释了零调用集合的大部分：27 个绕过单元格中有 17 个没有进行任何工具调用，因此不可能触发任何故障，它们占 55 个零调用 OPP 单元格中的 17 个（12.2%）；排除零调用单元格后，任务完成度的下降从 60% 提高到 67%。 这些运行尽管答案缺乏依据，得分却很高。 一个 LangChain/120b 对 unit_converter_000 的运行完全凭记忆完成所有换算，任务达成度得分 9.8、任务完成度得分 9.3，但工具恰当性只有 1.2。 这类答案在存在故障时推高了得分，却掩盖了实际部署中真正关心的内容，因此我们另外报告一种有依据达成度视角：仅当工具恰当性不低于 2 时才计入任务达成度。 在 OPP 下，低于该阈值的运行贡献了全部达成度得分的 16%（OP0：5%），因此有依据达成度下降 63% 而非 58%（配对下降 − 4.87 -4.87 分，95% CI [ − 5.27 , − 4.47 ] [-5.27,-4.47] ；OpenAI：68% 对 61%；表 5 ）。

paragraphs.en: LangChain achieves the highest OPP completion rate (95 to 97%), OpenAI the lowest (88 to 95%), and MCPBench is in between (91 to 95%) (Figure 4 a). Per-task score ratios (score OPP {}_{\text{OPP}} /score OP0 {}_{\text{OP0}} ) preserve the same ordering: LangChain has the highest median, MCPBench and OpenAI are lower with wider spread, and the ordering is stable whether failed runs are scored as zero or excluded (Figure 4 b). A linear mixed-effects model with stack, condition, and their interaction as fixed effects and task as random intercept yields one significant and one marginal interaction: against a common OPP effect of − 4.26 -4.26 points, MCPBench loses a further 0.93 points relative to LangChain (95% CI [ − 1.86 , − 0.01 ] [-1.86,-0.01] , p = 0.048 p=0.048 ) and OpenAI a further 0.84 ( [ − 1.77 , 0.08 ] [-1.77,0.08] , p = 0.074 p=0.074 ) (Figure 4 c). Both intervals reach close to zero, no multiplicity correction is applied, and MCPBench also receives more fault events per cell (Appendix C ), so we treat the framework effect as suggestive rather than established.
paragraphs.zh: LangChain 达到最高的 OPP 完成率（95% 至 97%），OpenAI 最低（88% 至 95%），MCPBench 居中（91% 至 95%）（图 4 a）。 逐任务的得分比率（score OPP {}_{\text{OPP}} /score OP0 {}_{\text{OP0}} ）保持了相同的排序：LangChain 中位数最高，MCPBench 和 OpenAI 较低且离散度更大，并且无论将失败的运行计为零分还是剔除，排序都保持稳定（图 4 b）。 以框架栈、条件及其交互作用为固定效应、任务为随机截距的线性混合效应模型得到一个显著和一个边缘的交互作用：相对于共同的 OPP 效应 − 4.26 -4.26 分，MCPBench 相比 LangChain 额外损失 0.93 分（95% CI [ − 1.86 , − 0.01 ] [-1.86,-0.01] ，p = 0.048 p=0.048 ），OpenAI 额外损失 0.84 分（ [ − 1.77 , 0.08 ] [-1.77,0.08] ，p = 0.074 p=0.074 ）（图 4 c）。 两个置信区间都接近零，未进行多重性校正，且 MCPBench 每个单元格还接收到更多故障事件（附录 C ），因此我们将框架效应视为提示性而非确证的结论。

paragraphs.en: The three stacks respond qualitatively differently (Figure 4 d, full analysis in Appendix G ). MCPBench is switch-dominant : after a failure, its planner re-plans with a different tool on the next round, consistent with its plan-and-execute loop that re-issues the full planned_tools list each iteration. LangChain and OpenAI are fallback-leaning : both exit the tool loop more often than they retry, consistent with their ReAct-style loops terminating once the LLM emits a text-only message.

paragraphs.en: Does model scale confer fault resilience beyond raw capability? The resilience question asks whether the 120b maintains a higher fraction of its own baseline under OPP than the 20b does. On this benchmark, the two backbones have similar fault-free scores on completed runs (OP0: 8.37 vs. 8.13 task-completion score; Proxy-off: 8.11 vs. 8.30).
paragraphs.zh: 模型规模是否在原生能力之外还能带来故障韧性？ 韧性问题探讨的是：在 OPP 条件下，120b 能否比 20b 保持更高比例的自身基线水平。 在该基准上，两个骨干模型在已完成运行的无故障得分相近（OP0：8.37 对比 8.13 的任务完成得分；Proxy-off：8.11 对比 8.30）。

sents.en: Does model scale confer fault resilience beyond raw capability?
sents.zh: 模型规模是否在原生能力之外还能带来故障韧性？

paragraphs.en: In a mixed-effects model of the per-cell resilience ratio (OPP over OP0 task-completion score, non-completions scored zero; task random intercept), the model-size coefficient is indistinguishable from zero ( β model = − 0.009 \beta_{\text{model}}=-0.009 , 95% CI [ − 0.39 , 0.37 ] [-0.39,0.37] , p = 0.96 p=0.96 ), and neither model × \times stack interaction is significant ( p ≥ 0.23 p\geq 0.23 ). The interval is wide: the data show no resilience benefit from scale for these two gpt-oss backbones under this serving setup, but cannot exclude a modest effect in either direction.

paragraphs.en: Pooled OPP rates conflate three components. Fault-free quality is similar for the two backbones (above). Fault-free completion is already lower for the 120b (OP0: 96.9% [93.7, 98.5] vs. 99.1% [96.8, 99.8], Wilson 95% CIs; Proxy-off: 96.0% vs. 98.7%). The fault-attributable drop, paired over identical (stack, task, seed) cells, is − - 5.8 points for the 120b (95% CI [ − 10.4 , − 1.4 ] [-10.4,-1.4] , exact McNemar p = 0.015 p=0.015 ) and − - 3.6 for the 20b ( [ − 7.2 , − 0.5 ] [-7.2,-0.5] , p = 0.039 p=0.039 ); the 2.2-point difference between them is not distinguishable from zero (95% CI [ − 3.0 , 7.5 ] [-3.0,7.5] ). The pooled OPP gap, 95.6% [92.0, 97.6] vs. 91.1% [86.7, 94.2] (difference 4.4 points, 95% CI [ − 0.2 , 9.3 ] [-0.2,9.3] , Fisher exact p = 0.088 p=0.088 ), is therefore half baseline completion and half a larger but uncertain fault-attributable drop, and we report it as descriptive rather than as an effect of scale. The 120b is lower in every stack, most for OpenAI (88% vs. 95%) and MCPBench (91% vs. 95%), the two stacks where raw error messages reach the model most directly (Table 4 ). When the 120b does complete under OPP, its answers score higher (3.68 vs. 3.26), so capability and resilience rankings need not agree.
paragraphs.zh: 汇总的 OPP 率混淆了三个组成部分。 两个骨干模型在无故障质量方面相似（见上文）。 120b 的无故障完成率本来就更低（OP0：96.9% [93.7, 98.5] vs. 99.1% [96.8, 99.8]，Wilson 95% 置信区间；Proxy-off：96.0% vs. 98.7%）。 在相同（stack、任务、种子）单元上配对比较，可归因于故障的下降，120b 为 −5.8 个百分点（95% 置信区间 [−10.4, −1.4]，精确 McNemar p = 0.015），20b 为 −3.6 个百分点（[−7.2, −0.5]，p = 0.039）；两者之间 2.2 个百分点的差异与零无法区分（95% 置信区间 [−3.0, 7.5]）。 汇总的 OPP 差距，95.6% [92.0, 97.6] vs. 91.1% [86.7, 94.2]（差异 4.4 个百分点，95% 置信区间 [−0.2, 9.3]，Fisher 精确检验 p = 0.088），因此一半来自基线完成率，一半来自更大但不确定的可归因于故障的下降，我们将其作为描述性结果报告，而非作为规模的影响。 120b 在每个 stack 中都更低，在 OpenAI（88% vs. 95%）和 MCPBench（91% vs. 95%）这两个原始错误信息最直接到达模型的 stack 中差距最大（表 4）。 当 120b 在 OPP 下确实完成时，其答案得分更高（3.68 vs. 3.26），因此能力排名与韧性排名无需一致。

paragraphs.en: Greater fault exposure is consistent with the gap but does not establish it. Under OPP the 120b receives more fault injections per cell than the 20b in every stack (mean 4.6 vs. 3.9), it produces longer outputs under OP0 (2,063 vs. 1,711 output tokens per cell), and its retry loops on a failing tool are slightly longer (mean 4.5 vs. 3.9 consecutive retries among the 38 flagged runs; Appendix G ). Its OPP non-completions (20 vs. 10) are wall-clock timeouts in all but two cases, not turn-budget exhaustion. The shared 16K-token context window and cross-stack differences in tool-call volume are co-equal alternative explanations (Section 7 ). Degradation is also strongly task-dependent: live APIs (game_trends, − - 97%) and deep sequential chains (national_parks, − - 82%) are far more vulnerable than short-chain computational tasks (unit_converter, − - 19%; Appendices D , G , H ).
paragraphs.zh: 更大的故障暴露度与该差距相一致，但并不能证明该差距由其导致。 在 OPP 下，120b 在每个单元格中收到的故障注入比 20b 更多（均值 4.6 对 3.9）；在 OP0 下，它产生更长的输出（每个单元格 2,063 对 1,711 个输出 token）；并且其在失败工具上的重试循环略长（在 38 个被标记的运行中，连续重试均值 4.5 对 3.9；附录 G）。 其 OPP 未完成情况（20 对 10）中除两例外均为墙钟超时，而非回合预算耗尽。 共享的 16K token 上下文窗口以及各模型栈之间工具调用量上的差异是同等重要的替代解释（第 7 节）。 性能退化还强烈依赖于任务：实时 API（game_trends，−97%）和深度顺序链（national_parks，−82%）远比短链计算任务（unit_converter，−19%）更脆弱（附录 D、G、H）。

paragraphs.en: The LLM judge is stochastic; five-fold scoring under randomized rubric order with median aggregation reduces but does not remove its noise, and the rubric rewards some ungrounded answers (Section 6.1 ). The fault profile inherits the reporting bias of GitHub issues, so we treat it as a stress profile (Section 4 ). Content operators omit schema drift, payload truncation, and partial result omission.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 评审具有随机性；在随机化评分标准顺序下的五折评分并取中位数聚合可以降低但不能消除其噪声，且该评分标准会奖励部分缺乏依据的回答（第 6.1 节）。 故障画像继承了 GitHub issue 的报告偏差，因此我们将其视为一种压力画像（第 4 节）。 内容算子忽略了模式漂移、载荷截断以及部分结果遗漏。

paragraphs.en: The proxy is non-intrusive (Appendix B ), and the per-run fault draw follows the profile (Appendix C ). Two explanations remain co-equal with fault exposure: the shared 16K-token context window, within which the 120b produces longer outputs, and tool-call volume (MCPBench cells receive 8.6 fault events on average against 2.3 for LangChain and 1.8 for OpenAI; 120b cells 4.6 against 3.9). Since stacks differ in both call volume and error handling, exposure and error handling remain partially entangled, and that longer tool-call chains amplify exposure is a hypothesis, not an established mechanism (Appendix H ). Zero-dose cells (12.2%) and three seeds per cell limit power for per-task comparisons and rare interactions.
paragraphs.zh: 该代理是无侵入式的（附录 B），且每次运行的故障抽取符合该分布（附录 C）。 仍有两种解释与故障暴露具有同等地位：共享的 16K token 上下文窗口（其中 120b 产生更长的输出），以及工具调用次数（MCPBench 单元平均接收 8.6 次故障事件，而 LangChain 为 2.3 次，OpenAI 为 1.8 次；120b 单元为 4.6 次，对照为 3.9 次）。 由于各技术栈在调用次数和错误处理上均存在差异，暴露与错误处理仍然部分纠缠在一起，而且更长的工具调用链会放大暴露这一说法只是一个假设，并非已确立的机制（附录 H）。 零故障单元（12.2%）以及每个单元仅三个随机种子，限制了单任务比较和罕见交互的统计效力。

paragraphs.en: Both backbones come from one model family under one serving setup. MCP-Bench is easy without faults (OP0 completion 95 to 100%, mean task-completion score 8.08, per-task means 4.8 to 9.9), which limits what the results say about harder workloads. The study is powered for the ecosystem’s 91%-permanent incident mix: TRANSIENT and INTERMITTENT entries produced 9 of 1,905 fired events, too few to characterize those regimes. The profile reflects the open-source MCP ecosystem as of September 2025; the stacks exclude multi-agent and human-in-the-loop workflows, and the 25 single-server tasks leave multi-server and longer-horizon settings to future benchmarks.
paragraphs.zh: 两个骨干模型均来自同一模型家族，并在同一服务配置下运行。 MCP-Bench 在无故障情况下较为简单（OP0 完成率为 95% 至 100%，任务完成平均得分为 8.08，单任务均值为 4.8 至 9.9），这限制了结果对更困难工作负载的说明力。 该研究以生态系统中 91% 永久性故障的构成为主要设计依据：TRANSIENT（瞬时）和 INTERMITTENT（间歇）条目在 1,905 个触发事件中仅产生 9 个，数量太少，无法刻画这些故障状态。 该特征画像反映的是截至 2025 年 9 月的开源 MCP 生态系统；这些技术栈不包含多智能体和人在回路的工作流，且 25 个单服务器任务将多服务器和更长时程的设置留待未来的基准测试。

sents.zh: 该研究以生态系统中 91% 永久性故障的构成为主要设计依据：TRANSIENT（瞬时）和 INTERMITTENT（间歇）条目在 1,905 个触发事件中仅产生 9 个，数量太少，无法刻画这些故障状态。

sents.en: The profile reflects the open-source MCP ecosystem as of September 2025; the stacks exclude multi-agent and human-in-the-loop workflows, and the 25 single-server tasks leave multi-server and longer-horizon settings to future benchmarks.
sents.zh: 该特征画像反映的是截至 2025 年 9 月的开源 MCP 生态系统；这些技术栈不包含多智能体和人在回路的工作流，且 25 个单服务器任务将多服务器和更长时程的设置留待未来的基准测试。

paragraphs.en: MCP-Injector is a dual-use middleware: used as intended, it enables reproducible pre-deployment stress testing against a fault profile calibrated to the observed incident distribution of the public MCP ecosystem; as a transparent MCP interposition layer, its operator primitives (fabricated errors, delays, silent drops, perturbed payloads) could be repurposed adversarially by an attacker already positioned on the MCP path. Since the profile is shaped by the reporting bias of public GitHub artifacts (Section 4 ), it should be treated as a stress test rather than a certification instrument. We mitigate these risks by shipping OP0 as the default, tagging injected responses with a fault header so cooperating loggers can distinguish synthetic from real faults, and scoping documentation to pre-deployment use in staging environments.
paragraphs.zh: MCP-Injector 是一款双用途中间件：按预期使用时，它支持针对一个依据公共 MCP 生态实际事件分布校准的故障画像开展可复现的部署前压力测试；作为一个透明的 MCP 介入层，其操作者原语（伪造错误、延迟、静默丢弃、被篡改的载荷）也可能被已位于 MCP 路径上的攻击者以对抗方式重新利用。 由于该画像受公共 GitHub 工件报告偏差的影响（第 4 节），应将其视为压力测试工具而非认证工具。 我们通过以下方式缓解这些风险：默认以 OP0 交付，为注入的响应打上故障头部以便协作式日志器能够区分合成故障与真实故障，并将文档的范围限定为在预发布（staging）环境中进行部署前使用。

paragraphs.en: Existing tool-use benchmarks [ 16 , 30 , 31 , 27 , 19 , 28 , 4 , 17 ] measure success rates assuming tools respond correctly and on time; Xiong et al. [ 29 ] study parameter-filling failures inside the LLM rather than the external tool, and Agent-SafetyBench [ 33 ] and Ruan et al. [ 23 ] address adversarial threats rather than non-adversarial operational faults. ReliabilityBench [ 10 ] is closest to our work, evaluating fault tolerance under timeouts, rate limits, and schema drift; MCP-Injector differs in that its fault model is calibrated to the incident distribution mined from 1,774 MCP repositories, it models persistence schedules (permanent, transient, intermittent), and it operates as a transparent middleware requiring no agent modification.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的工具使用基准 [ 16 , 30 , 31 , 27 , 19 , 28 , 4 , 17 ] 在假设工具能正确且按时响应的前提下测量成功率；Xiong 等人 [ 29 ] 研究的是大语言模型内部的参数填充失败，而非外部工具；Agent-SafetyBench [ 33 ] 与 Ruan 等人 [ 23 ] 关注的是对抗性威胁，而非非对抗性的运行故障。 ReliabilityBench [ 10 ] 与我们的工作最为接近，评估超时、速率限制和模式漂移下的容错能力；MCP-Injector 的不同之处在于，其故障模型是根据从 1,774 个 MCP 代码仓库中挖掘出的事故分布进行校准的，它对故障持续性模式（永久性、瞬时性、间歇性）进行了建模，并且它以透明中间件的形式运行，无需修改智能体。

paragraphs.en: Classical fault injection evaluates system dependability by deliberately introducing faults at hardware, OS, or API boundaries [ 20 , 5 ] . Chaos engineering [ 2 ] extends this philosophy to production distributed systems, and Yu et al. [ 32 ] survey its application to microservice architectures. Recent work applies chaos engineering principles to LLM-based systems: Owotogbe [ 22 ] proposes a framework for injecting agent communication failures in multi-agent systems, and Kikuta et al. [ 13 ] use LLMs to automate the chaos engineering cycle on Kubernetes. These efforts target infrastructure-level or inter-agent faults. MCP-Injector operates at a different layer, the MCP tool-call interface, injecting semantic faults (content errors, timing failures, schema violations) that exercise agent-level interpretation and recovery logic.
paragraphs.zh: 经典故障注入通过在硬件、操作系统或 API 边界处故意引入故障来评估系统的可依赖性 [ 20 , 5 ] 。 混沌工程 [ 2 ] 将这一理念扩展到生产环境分布式系统，Yu 等人 [ 32 ] 综述了其在微服务架构中的应用。 近期工作将混沌工程原则应用于基于大语言模型（LLM）的系统：Owotogbe [ 22 ] 提出了一个在多智能体系统中注入智能体通信故障的框架，Kikuta 等人 [ 13 ] 利用大语言模型在 Kubernetes 上自动化混沌工程循环。 这些工作针对的是基础设施层面或智能体间故障。 MCP-Injector 则工作在不同的层面，即 MCP 工具调用接口，注入语义故障（内容错误、时序故障、模式违规），以检验智能体层面的解释与恢复逻辑。

[ 12 ] catalogue MCP security risks and tool-invocation failure categories post hoc, and self-correction approaches such as Reflexion [ 25 ] improve robustness but assume tools are reliable; MCP-Injector instead provides a controlled, reproducible mechanism to induce realistic MCP failures and measure their impact on agent performance.

paragraphs.en: We presented MCP-Injector, a protocol-aware fault-injection middleware for MCP with a fault model calibrated to the observed incident distribution of the public MCP ecosystem (57,240 threads across 1,774 open-source repositories). Our 1,350-cell evaluation yields three findings. First, under this permanent-heavy stress profile, MCP faults cause severe quality degradation (60% drop in task-completion score; paired difference − 4.85 -4.85 points, 95% CI [ − 5.22 , − 4.48 ] [-5.22,-4.48] ), with partial degradation, not catastrophic failure, the most common outcome (56% of cells). Second, framework-level error handling appears to matter more than model scale (one significant and one marginal stack × \times condition interaction, p = 0.048 p=0.048 and 0.074 0.074 ): stacks differ in whether faults cascade or are absorbed, although this evidence is suggestive. Third, for the two gpt-oss backbones tested, scale does not purchase fault tolerance: the 120B retains no larger share of its fault-free score under faults and completes descriptively fewer tasks, with greater fault exposure a candidate explanation rather than an established mechanism. Open directions: multi-server orchestration, longer-horizon tasks, and mitigations such as fault-aware planning.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 MCP-Injector，一个面向 MCP 的协议感知故障注入中间件，其故障模型依据对公共 MCP 生态系统观测到的事件分布进行校准（涵盖 1,774 个开源仓库中的 57,240 个线程）。 我们包含 1,350 个单元格的评估得出三项发现。 第一，在这种以永久性故障为主的压力配置下，MCP 故障会造成严重的质量下降（任务完成得分下降 60%；配对差值 −4.85 分，95% 置信区间 [−5.22, −4.48]），其中部分退化而非灾难性失败是最常见的结果（占 56% 的单元格）。 第二，框架层面的错误处理似乎比模型规模更重要（一个显著和一个边缘的堆栈 × 条件交互作用，p = 0.048 和 0.074）：各堆栈在故障是级联扩散还是被吸收方面存在差异，尽管这一证据仅具提示性。 第三，对于所测试的两个 gpt-oss 骨干模型而言，规模并不能换来容错能力：在故障条件下，120B 模型保留的无故障得分份额并不更大，且在描述意义上完成的任务更少，更大的故障暴露是一个候选解释而非已确立的机制。 未来方向：多服务器编排、更长时程的任务，以及诸如故障感知规划等缓解措施。

sents.en: Second, framework-level error handling appears to matter more than model scale (one significant and one marginal stack × \times condition interaction, p = 0.048 p=0.048 and 0.074 0.074 ): stacks differ in whether faults cascade or are absorbed, although this evidence is suggestive.

paragraphs.en: This appendix documents how each field of the calibrated OPP profile consumed by MCP-Injector (file fault_modes/fault_mode_1.json ) is obtained from the mined corpus of Section 4 . The profile contains 18 entries, one per combination of six operators (OP1 through OP6) and three injectable persistence types (INTERMITTENT, PERMANENT, TRANSIENT). Each entry specifies three kinds of values: (i) a selection weight ( probability ), (ii) a persistence schedule parameter ( activation_p , and for INTERMITTENT also deactivation_p ), and (iii) operator-specific content parameters ( duration , delta_ratio , probability_per_word ). We describe how each is set, separating values that are mechanically derived from the mined distribution (Table 2 ) from hyperparameters that are fixed on principled grounds. Table 3 lists every entry alongside its source counts.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录记录了 MCP-Injector 所使用的已校准 OPP 配置文件（文件 fault_modes/fault_mode_1.json）中每个字段是如何从第 4 节的挖掘语料库中获得的。 该配置文件包含 18 个条目，对应六个算子（OP1 至 OP6）与三种可注入持久化类型（INTERMITTENT、PERMANENT、TRANSIENT）的每种组合。 每个条目指定三类值：(i) 选择权重（probability），(ii) 持久化调度参数（activation_p，INTERMITTENT 还包括 deactivation_p），以及 (iii) 算子特定的内容参数（duration、delta_ratio、probability_per_word）。 我们描述每个值是如何设置的，将机械地从挖掘分布（表 2）导出的值与基于原则性理由而固定的超参数区分开来。 表 3 列出了每个条目及其来源计数。

paragraphs.en: The six operators implement one mined failure mode each: DELAYED_RESPONSE maps to OP5, EXPLICIT_ERROR to OP4, INCORRECT_OUTPUT to OP2, INVALID_OUTPUT to OP3, MINOR_MISTAKE to OP1, and SILENT_DROP to OP6. The UNCERTAIN mode row and the UNCERTAIN persistence column of Table 2 are excluded from the profile because they carry no actionable (mode, persistence) label. The NON_FAILURE row is also excluded, since non-failures are represented by the null injector (OP0) used in the no-fault baseline OP0.

paragraphs.en: where N = 13,824 N=13{,}824 is the sum of all injectable cells in Table 2 (that is, the three injectable persistence columns for the six mined failure modes, excluding UNCERTAIN). This preserves the empirical joint distribution of (failure mode, persistence) as a probability mass function over the 18 operator-persistence entries, with the rare UNCERTAIN mass reassigned proportionally. paragraphs.zh: 公式 (2) 旨在用于一种在故障阶段和正常阶段之间交替的两状态调度，其每次调用的转移概率为 a = 𝚊𝚌𝚝𝚒𝚟𝚊𝚝𝚒𝚘𝚗 ​ _ ​ 𝚙 a=\mathtt{activation\_p} 和 d = 𝚍𝚎𝚊𝚌𝚝𝚒𝚟𝚊𝚝𝚒𝚘𝚗 ​ _ ​ 𝚙 d=\mathtt{deactivation\_p}，其平稳故障比例为 a / ( a + d ) a/(a+d)；将该比例设置为被归类为 INTERMITTENT（间歇性）而非 PERMANENT（永久性）的该模式的复现（非瞬态）观测所占的比例，可得：

paragraphs.en: We fix d = 0.3 d=0.3 across all entries (see below), which determines a a uniquely for each operator. For instance, DELAYED_RESPONSE has INT / PERM = 51 / 157 \mathrm{INT}/\mathrm{PERM}=51/157 , giving a = 0.3 ⋅ 51 / 157 ≈ 0.0975 a=0.3\cdot 51/157\approx 0.0975 . All six INTERMITTENT activation probabilities in the profile are reproduced by Equation ( 2 ) to four decimal places. The shipped injector, however, uses these parameters differently: once an INTERMITTENT entry is drawn, each call fires independently with probability a a , and from the next call on the entry is released with probability d d per call, after which a new entry is drawn from the profile. The faulty fraction while the entry is held is therefore a a rather than a / ( a + d ) a/(a+d) , and an episode spans 1 + 1 / d ≈ 4.3 1+1/d\approx 4.3 calls on average, so it is expected to fire a ⁡ ( 1 + 1 / d ) ≤ 0.42 a(1+1/d)\leq 0.42 times. The six activation probabilities are data-derived in the sense of Equation ( 2 ), but under the implemented schedule INTERMITTENT entries fire far less often than the mined INT/(INT+PERM) ratios imply, consistent with the 6 INTERMITTENT events in the fired-faults log (Appendix C ).

paragraphs.en: Equation ( 2 ) identifies only the ratio a / d a/d from data. The mined threads do not provide reliable episode-length statistics (GitHub issues rarely report call-level burst lengths), so d d is a free hyperparameter. In the two-state design it sets the mean faulty burst to 1 / d ≈ 3.3 1/d\approx 3.3 calls; in the shipped injector it sets how long a drawn INTERMITTENT entry is held ( 1 + 1 / d ≈ 4.3 1+1/d\approx 4.3 calls on average). Either way the episode is short relative to the execution loops (up to 25 or 40 rounds per task), so a single INTERMITTENT episode does not monopolize a task execution. Choosing a common d d for all operators keeps the calibration one-dimensional per mode and ensures that cross-operator comparisons of INTERMITTENT effects are not confounded by different episode lengths. The loop bounds themselves differ across stacks and are documented in Appendix F .
paragraphs.zh: 公式 ( 2 ) 仅能从数据中识别出比值 a / d。 挖掘到的论坛帖子无法提供可靠的事件长度统计信息（GitHub issue 很少报告调用级的突发长度），因此 d 是一个自由超参数。 在双状态设计中，它将故障突发的平均长度设为 1 / d ≈ 3.3 次调用；在最终发布的注入器中，它决定一条被抽取的 INTERMITTENT 条目被保持的时长（平均 1 + 1 / d ≈ 4.3 次调用）。 无论哪种方式，事件相对于执行循环（每个任务最多 25 或 40 轮）都很短，因此单个 INTERMITTENT 事件不会独占一次任务执行。 为所有算子选择同一个 d，使每种模式的校准保持一维，并确保跨算子比较 INTERMITTENT 效果时不会因不同的事件长度而产生混淆。 各个技术栈的循环上限本身有所不同，已在附录 F 中说明。

paragraphs.en: The MCP HTTP transport timeout is 60 seconds (Section 5.1 , default in benchmark_config.yaml ). We set 𝚍𝚞𝚛𝚊𝚝𝚒𝚘𝚗 = 30 \mathtt{duration}=30 seconds: half the HTTP timeout, which is an order of magnitude above typical healthy tool latency (a few seconds) and therefore clearly disruptive, but strictly below the transport cutoff so that OP5 remains distinct from OP6 (SILENT_DROP) and from OP4 (EXPLICIT_ERROR) at the protocol boundary. Longer values would cause transport-level timeouts and collapse DELAYED_RESPONSE into SILENT_DROP; shorter values would risk being absorbed by the agent’s natural per-call variance and not register as a delay.
paragraphs.zh: MCP 的 HTTP 传输超时时间为 60 秒（第 5.1 节，benchmark_config.yaml 中的默认值）。 我们设置 𝚍𝚞𝚛𝚊𝚝𝚒𝚘𝚗 = 30 \mathtt{duration}=30 秒：即 HTTP 超时的一半，这一数值比典型的正常工具延迟（几秒钟）高出整整一个数量级，因此明显具有干扰性；同时它又严格低于传输层截止时间，从而使 OP5 与 OP6（SILENT_DROP）以及 OP4（协议边界处的 EXPLICIT_ERROR）保持明确区分。 更长的取值会导致传输层超时，使 DELAYED_RESPONSE 与 SILENT_DROP 混同；更短的取值则可能被智能体本身的单次调用波动所吸收，从而不会被识别为延迟。

paragraphs.en: OP1 (MINOR_MISTAKE) and OP2 (INCORRECT_OUTPUT) both act word-by-word on the response, but realize qualitatively different failure modes. OP1 mutates each selected word by a single-character substitution of magnitude controlled by delta_ratio ; OP2 replaces each selected word by a random value of the same type. The parameters are chosen to reflect the semantic separation between the two modes. OP1 uses 𝚙𝚛𝚘𝚋𝚊𝚋𝚒𝚕𝚒𝚝𝚢 ​ _ ​ 𝚙𝚎𝚛 ​ _ ​ 𝚠𝚘𝚛𝚍 = 0.08 \mathtt{probability\_per\_word}=0.08 and 𝚍𝚎𝚕𝚝𝚊 ​ _ ​ 𝚛𝚊𝚝𝚒𝚘 = 0.05 \mathtt{delta\_ratio}=0.05 , yielding sparse, low-magnitude perturbations that leave most of the response intact, consistent with the MINOR_MISTAKE label (small deviation, structurally valid). The 5% delta level is the canonical minor-perturbation intensity used in perturbation-robustness literature. OP2 uses 𝚙𝚛𝚘𝚋𝚊𝚋𝚒𝚕𝚒𝚝𝚢 ​ _ ​ 𝚙𝚎𝚛 ​ _ ​ 𝚠𝚘𝚛𝚍 = 0.35 \mathtt{probability\_per\_word}=0.35 , which corrupts roughly one third of the response, consistent with INCORRECT_OUTPUT (semantically wrong but structurally valid). We avoid values close to 1 because a fully garbled response typically fails downstream JSON parsing, collapsing OP2 into OP3 (INVALID_OUTPUT). The 0.08 vs. 0.35 gap preserves a clear intensity ordering between the two content operators; the mined corpus does not support finer tuning because threads rarely quantify the numeric extent of a "minor" versus "wrong" response.
paragraphs.zh: OP1（MINOR_MISTAKE）和OP2（INCORRECT_OUTPUT）都对响应逐词作用，但实现了性质不同的故障模式。 OP1通过由delta_ratio控制幅度的单字符替换来变异每个选中的词；OP2则用一个同类型的随机值替换每个选中的词。 这些参数的选取反映了两种模式之间的语义差异。 OP1使用 probability_per_word = 0.08 和 delta_ratio = 0.05，产生稀疏、低幅度的扰动，使响应的大部分保持不变，这与MINOR_MISTAKE标签（小幅偏差、结构有效）一致。 5%的delta水平是扰动鲁棒性文献中使用的规范的小扰动强度。 OP2使用 probability_per_word = 0.35，这会破坏大约三分之一的响应，与INCORRECT_OUTPUT（语义错误但结构有效）一致。 我们避免取接近1的值，因为完全乱码的响应通常无法通过下游的JSON解析，从而把OP2坍缩为OP3（INVALID_OUTPUT）。 0.08与0.35之间的差距在两个内容操作符之间保持了明确的强度排序；所挖掘的语料不支持更精细的调优，因为帖子很少量化“轻微”与“错误”响应在数值程度上的差异。

sents.zh: OP1（MINOR_MISTAKE）和OP2（INCORRECT_OUTPUT）都对响应逐词作用，但实现了性质不同的故障模式。

sents.en: OP1 mutates each selected word by a single-character substitution of magnitude controlled by delta_ratio ; OP2 replaces each selected word by a random value of the same type.
sents.zh: OP1通过由delta_ratio控制幅度的单字符替换来变异每个选中的词；OP2则用一个同类型的随机值替换每个选中的词。

sents.en: The parameters are chosen to reflect the semantic separation between the two modes.
sents.zh: 这些参数的选取反映了两种模式之间的语义差异。

sents.en: OP1 uses 𝚙𝚛𝚘𝚋𝚊𝚋𝚒𝚕𝚒𝚝𝚢 ​ _ ​ 𝚙𝚎𝚛 ​ _ ​ 𝚠𝚘𝚛𝚍 = 0.08 \mathtt{probability\_per\_word}=0.08 and 𝚍𝚎𝚕𝚝𝚊 ​ _ ​ 𝚛𝚊𝚝𝚒𝚘 = 0.05 \mathtt{delta\_ratio}=0.05 , yielding sparse, low-magnitude perturbations that leave most of the response intact, consistent with the MINOR_MISTAKE label (small deviation, structurally valid).
sents.zh: OP1使用 probability_per_word = 0.08 和 delta_ratio = 0.05，产生稀疏、低幅度的扰动，使响应的大部分保持不变，这与MINOR_MISTAKE标签（小幅偏差、结构有效）一致。

sents.en: The 5% delta level is the canonical minor-perturbation intensity used in perturbation-robustness literature.
sents.zh: 5%的delta水平是扰动鲁棒性文献中使用的规范的小扰动强度。

sents.en: OP2 uses 𝚙𝚛𝚘𝚋𝚊𝚋𝚒𝚕𝚒𝚝𝚢 ​ _ ​ 𝚙𝚎𝚛 ​ _ ​ 𝚠𝚘𝚛𝚍 = 0.35 \mathtt{probability\_per\_word}=0.35 , which corrupts roughly one third of the response, consistent with INCORRECT_OUTPUT (semantically wrong but structurally valid).
sents.zh: OP2使用 probability_per_word = 0.35，这会破坏大约三分之一的响应，与INCORRECT_OUTPUT（语义错误但结构有效）一致。

sents.en: We avoid values close to 1 because a fully garbled response typically fails downstream JSON parsing, collapsing OP2 into OP3 (INVALID_OUTPUT).
sents.zh: 我们避免取接近1的值，因为完全乱码的响应通常无法通过下游的JSON解析，从而把OP2坍缩为OP3（INVALID_OUTPUT）。

sents.en: The 0.08 vs. 0.35 gap preserves a clear intensity ordering between the two content operators; the mined corpus does not support finer tuning because threads rarely quantify the numeric extent of a "minor" versus "wrong" response.
sents.zh: 0.08与0.35之间的差距在两个内容操作符之间保持了明确的强度排序；所挖掘的语料不支持更精细的调优，因为帖子很少量化“轻微”与“错误”响应在数值程度上的差异。

paragraphs.en: These operators take no tunable parameters. OP3 deterministically casts the response to a type that violates the tool’s schema, OP4 raises a structured MCP error, and OP6 suspends the call indefinitely. Their behavior is fully specified by the persistence schedule and requires no additional calibration.
paragraphs.zh: 这些算子不接受任何可调参数。 OP3 确定性地将响应转换为违反工具模式的类型，OP4 抛出结构化的 MCP 错误，OP6 则无限期挂起该调用。 它们的行为完全由持久化调度规定，无需额外的校准。

paragraphs.en: The experimental design requires that the proxy with null injection (OP0) is outcome-equivalent to the no-proxy baseline (proxy-off). We test this by comparing task-quality scores and execution latency across all six (stack, model) combinations.
paragraphs.zh: 实验设计要求带空注入的代理（OP0）在不注入任何结果（no-proxy）基线（proxy-off）下与无结果（outcome-equivalent）等价。 我们通过比较全部六种（技术栈，模型）组合的任务质量得分和执行延迟来验证这一点。

sents.en: The experimental design requires that the proxy with null injection (OP0) is outcome-equivalent to the no-proxy baseline (proxy-off).
sents.zh: 实验设计要求带空注入的代理（OP0）在不注入任何结果（no-proxy）基线（proxy-off）下与无结果（outcome-equivalent）等价。

sents.en: We test this by comparing task-quality scores and execution latency across all six (stack, model) combinations.
sents.zh: 我们通过比较全部六种（技术栈，模型）组合的任务质量得分和执行延迟来验证这一点。

paragraphs.en: For each (stack, model) pair, we run paired Wilcoxon signed-rank tests on three composite metrics (task completion, tool selection, planning effectiveness) between proxy-off and OP0, pairing by (task, seed). After Bonferroni correction across 18 tests (6 pairs × \times 3 metrics), no comparison reaches significance at α = 0.05 \alpha=0.05 . The smallest uncorrected p p is mcpbench/20b on planning effectiveness ( p uncorr = 0.003 p_{\text{uncorr}}=0.003 , r = 0.40 r=0.40 , Bonferroni p = 0.050 p=0.050 ), followed by mcpbench/20b on tool selection ( p uncorr = 0.006 p_{\text{uncorr}}=0.006 , r = 0.39 r=0.39 , Bonferroni p = 0.10 p=0.10 ); all three mcpbench/20b deltas are small and negative ( − 0.27 -0.27 to − 0.45 -0.45 points), so a slight proxy effect in that cell cannot be excluded. Mean score deltas are small: the largest absolute difference is 0.55 points (openai/120b task completion), with no consistent direction across stacks, confirming that the proxy does not systematically bias scores.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个 (stack, model) 组合，我们在三个综合指标（任务完成度、工具选择、规划有效性）上，按 (task, seed) 配对，对 proxy-off 与 OP0 进行配对 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验。 经过对 18 次检验（6 组配对 \times 3 个指标）进行 Bonferroni 校正后，没有任何比较在 α = 0.05 \alpha=0.05 水平上达到显著性。 未校正的最小 p p 值来自 mcpbench/20b 在规划有效性上（ p uncorr = 0.003 p_{\text{uncorr}}=0.003 ， r = 0.40 r=0.40 ，Bonferroni p = 0.050 p=0.050 ），其次是 mcpbench/20b 在工具选择上（ p uncorr = 0.006 p_{\text{uncorr}}=0.006 ， r = 0.39 r=0.39 ，Bonferroni p = 0.10 p=0.10 ）；mcpbench/20b 的三个差值都很小且为负（ − 0.27 -0.27 到 − 0.45 -0.45 分），因此无法排除该单元格中存在轻微的代理效应。 平均分数差值很小：最大的绝对差异为 0.55 分（openai/120b 任务完成度），且在各 stack 之间没有一致的方向，这证实了代理不会系统性地使分数产生偏差。

paragraphs.en: Mean execution-time deltas (OP0 minus proxy-off) range from − - 22 s (langchain/120b) to + + 7 s (mcpbench/120b) in absolute seconds, and from − - 12% (openai/20b) to + + 21% (langchain/20b) as a fraction of the proxy-off baseline. The negative delta for LangChain reflects run-to-run variance in LLM inference time rather than proxy-induced speedup. Expressed as per-tool-call overhead, the proxy adds an estimated 0.1 to 0.5 s per tool invocation, which is negligible relative to LLM inference latency (typically 2 to 15 s per turn). Figure 5 shows the distribution of latency deltas by stack.
paragraphs.zh: 平均执行时间差（OP0 减去关闭代理的情况）以绝对秒数计，范围从 − - 22 秒（langchain/120b）到 + + 7 秒（mcpbench/120b）；以关闭代理基线的百分比计，范围从 − - 12%（openai/20b）到 + + 21%（langchain/20b）。 LangChain 的负差值反映的是大语言模型推理时间的运行间波动，而非代理带来的加速。 以每次工具调用的开销表示，代理为每次工具调用增加约 0.1 至 0.5 秒的估计开销，相对于大语言模型推理延迟（通常每轮 2 至 15 秒）而言可以忽略不计。 图 5 展示了各技术栈延迟差值的分布情况。

paragraphs.en: The proxy satisfies the non-intrusiveness requirement: OP0 is a valid fault-free baseline, and all subsequent OP0-vs-OPP comparisons are not confounded by instrumentation artifacts.
paragraphs.zh: 该代理满足非侵入性要求：OP0 是一个有效的无故障基线，且所有后续的 OP0 与 OPP 对比都不会受到插桩伪影的干扰。

paragraphs.en: This section checks how the specified profile translates into realized fault events under OPP and whether fault exposure is sufficient to support causal claims. We define the fault dose of an experimental cell as the number of fault injection events fired by the proxy during that cell’s execution, computed by counting the cell’s entries in the fired-faults log. Dose ranges from zero (when the agent makes no tool call, or draws an INTERMITTENT entry that never fires) to several dozen, depending on tool-call volume and the persistence state of each triggered fault.
paragraphs.zh: 本节检查所指定的故障画像在 OPP 下如何转化为实际发生的故障事件，以及故障暴露是否足以支持因果性结论。 我们将一个实验单元的故障剂量定义为代理在该单元执行期间触发的故障注入事件的数量，通过统计该单元在已触发故障日志中的条目数来计算。 故障剂量的范围从零（当智能体不进行任何工具调用，或抽到从未触发的 INTERMITTENT 条目时）到几十次不等，具体取决于工具调用量以及每个被触发故障的持续状态。

paragraphs.en: We compare the specified (fault operator × \times persistence) selection weights with the realized frequencies in the fired-faults log: 1,905 fired events from the 395 OPP cells with at least one injection (Figure 6 ). The per-event realized mix departs detectably from the specified weights ( χ 2 = 684.5 \chi^{2}=684.5 , df = 16 \mathrm{df}=16 over the 17 entries with non-zero weight, p < 0.001 p<0.001 ; Cramér’s V = 0.15 V=0.15 ; total variation distance 0.20 0.20 ). EXPLICIT_ERROR/PERMANENT remains the dominant entry (65.6% specified, 59.5% realized), but INCORRECT_OUTPUT/PERMANENT (OP2) rises from 12.5% to 28.9%; PERMANENT entries account for 99.5% of fired events against 91.3% of the weight, and INTERMITTENT entries (8.0% of the weight) fire only 6 times (0.3%). The departure reflects how the profile is consumed rather than a sampling error. Selection weights apply per draw, not per event: the injector draws an entry at the first tool call of a run, and a PERMANENT draw then fires on every subsequent call, so each such run contributes as many events as it makes tool calls. Event volume per draw depends on the entry and the stack: runs under OP2/PERMANENT, whose perturbed outputs return as successes, average 7.5 fired events, against 4.2 under EXPLICIT_ERROR/PERMANENT, a gap that holds within every stack; and MCPBench runs contribute 68% of all events (mean 8.6 per cell, versus 2.3 for LangChain and 1.8 for OpenAI). INTERMITTENT entries fire on a given call only with activation probability a ≤ 0.10 a\leq 0.10 , and the median OPP cell makes two tool calls, so these entries rarely fire. At the level of the draw itself, the first fired entry of each run is consistent with the specified weights renormalized over the PERMANENT and TRANSIENT entries (391 runs; Monte Carlo p = 0.22 p=0.22 , V = 0.06 V=0.06 ), although OP2/PERMANENT is drawn more often than expected (74 runs against 53). The profile thus fixes what is drawn, while persistence and agent behavior determine how many faults each draw delivers. Analyses that condition on exposure (zero-dose cells and exposure versus dose, below) use realized doses from the fired-faults log, and the OPP versus OP0 contrasts of Section 6.1 compare conditions as assigned, so neither depends on the per-event mix matching the profile.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将指定的（故障算子 × \times 持久性）选择权重与已触发故障日志中的实际频率进行比较：来自至少有一次注入的 395 个 OPP 单元的 1,905 个已触发事件（图 6）。 每个事件的实际混合比例与指定权重存在可检测的偏离（ χ 2 = 684.5 \chi^{2}=684.5 ，在 17 个权重非零的条目上 df = 16 \mathrm{df}=16 ， p < 0.001 p<0.001 ；Cramér's V = 0.15 V=0.15 ；总变异距离 0.20 0.20 ）。 EXPLICIT_ERROR/PERMANENT 仍占主导地位（指定 65.6%，实际 59.5%），但 INCORRECT_OUTPUT/PERMANENT（OP2）从 12.5% 上升到 28.9%；PERMANENT 条目占已触发事件的 99.5%，而其权重为 91.3%，INTERMITTENT 条目（权重 8.0%）仅触发 6 次（0.3%）。 这种偏离反映的是配置档案被消费的方式，而非抽样误差。 选择权重按每次抽取适用，而非按每个事件适用：注入器在每次运行首次工具调用时抽取一个条目，随后 PERMANENT 抽取在之后每次调用中都会触发，因此每次这样的运行贡献的事件数量与其工具调用次数相同。 每次抽取的事件量取决于条目和栈：在 OP2/PERMANENT 下的运行中，其受扰动输出以成功形式返回，平均触发 7.5 个事件，而 EXPLICIT_ERROR/PERMANENT 下为 4.2 个，这一差距在每个栈内均成立；且 MCPBench 运行贡献了所有事件的 68%（每单元平均 8.6 次，相比之下 LangChain 为 2.3 次，OpenAI 为 1.8 次）。 INTERMITTENT 条目在给定调用中仅以激活概率 a ≤ 0.10 a\leq 0.10 触发，且 OPP 单元的中位数工具调用次数为两次，因此这些条目很少触发。 就抽取本身而言，每次运行的首次触发条目与在 PERMANENT 和 TRANSIENT 条目上重新归一化后的指定权重一致（391 次运行；蒙特卡洛 p = 0.22 p=0.22 ， V = 0.06 V=0.06 ），尽管 OP2/PERMANENT 被抽取的次数多于预期（74 次对 53 次）。 因此，配置档案决定了抽取什么，而持久性和智能体行为决定了每次抽取交付多少故障。 以暴露为条件的分析（下文的零剂量单元以及暴露与剂量对比）使用来自已触发故障日志的实际剂量，而第 6.1 节的 OPP 与 OP0 对比则按分配的条件进行比较，因此两者都不依赖于每事件混合与配置档案的匹配。

sents.en: We compare the specified (fault operator × \times persistence) selection weights with the realized frequencies in the fired-faults log: 1,905 fired events from the 395 OPP cells with at least one injection (Figure 6 ).
sents.zh: 我们将指定的（故障算子 × \times 持久性）选择权重与已触发故障日志中的实际频率进行比较：来自至少有一次注入的 395 个 OPP 单元的 1,905 个已触发事件（图 6）。

sents.en: The per-event realized mix departs detectably from the specified weights ( χ 2 = 684.5 \chi^{2}=684.5 , df = 16 \mathrm{df}=16 over the 17 entries with non-zero weight, p < 0.001 p<0.001 ; Cramér’s V = 0.15 V=0.15 ; total variation distance 0.20 0.20 ).
sents.zh: 每个事件的实际混合比例与指定权重存在可检测的偏离（ χ 2 = 684.5 \chi^{2}=684.5 ，在 17 个权重非零的条目上 df = 16 \mathrm{df}=16 ， p < 0.001 p<0.001 ；Cramér's V = 0.15 V=0.15 ；总变异距离 0.20 0.20 ）。

sents.en: EXPLICIT_ERROR/PERMANENT remains the dominant entry (65.6% specified, 59.5% realized), but INCORRECT_OUTPUT/PERMANENT (OP2) rises from 12.5% to 28.9%; PERMANENT entries account for 99.5% of fired events against 91.3% of the weight, and INTERMITTENT entries (8.0% of the weight) fire only 6 times (0.3%).
sents.zh: EXPLICIT_ERROR/PERMANENT 仍占主导地位（指定 65.6%，实际 59.5%），但 INCORRECT_OUTPUT/PERMANENT（OP2）从 12.5% 上升到 28.9%；PERMANENT 条目占已触发事件的 99.5%，而其权重为 91.3%，INTERMITTENT 条目（权重 8.0%）仅触发 6 次（0.3%）。

sents.en: The departure reflects how the profile is consumed rather than a sampling error.
sents.zh: 这种偏离反映的是配置档案被消费的方式，而非抽样误差。

sents.en: Selection weights apply per draw, not per event: the injector draws an entry at the first tool call of a run, and a PERMANENT draw then fires on every subsequent call, so each such run contributes as many events as it makes tool calls.
sents.zh: 选择权重按每次抽取适用，而非按每个事件适用：注入器在每次运行首次工具调用时抽取一个条目，随后 PERMANENT 抽取在之后每次调用中都会触发，因此每次这样的运行贡献的事件数量与其工具调用次数相同。

sents.en: Event volume per draw depends on the entry and the stack: runs under OP2/PERMANENT, whose perturbed outputs return as successes, average 7.5 fired events, against 4.2 under EXPLICIT_ERROR/PERMANENT, a gap that holds within every stack; and MCPBench runs contribute 68% of all events (mean 8.6 per cell, versus 2.3 for LangChain and 1.8 for OpenAI).
sents.zh: 每次抽取的事件量取决于条目和栈：在 OP2/PERMANENT 下的运行中，其受扰动输出以成功形式返回，平均触发 7.5 个事件，而 EXPLICIT_ERROR/PERMANENT 下为 4.2 个，这一差距在每个栈内均成立；且 MCPBench 运行贡献了所有事件的 68%（每单元平均 8.6 次，相比之下 LangChain 为 2.3 次，OpenAI 为 1.8 次）。

sents.en: INTERMITTENT entries fire on a given call only with activation probability a ≤ 0.10 a\leq 0.10 , and the median OPP cell makes two tool calls, so these entries rarely fire.
sents.zh: INTERMITTENT 条目在给定调用中仅以激活概率 a ≤ 0.10 a\leq 0.10 触发，且 OPP 单元的中位数工具调用次数为两次，因此这些条目很少触发。

sents.en: At the level of the draw itself, the first fired entry of each run is consistent with the specified weights renormalized over the PERMANENT and TRANSIENT entries (391 runs; Monte Carlo p = 0.22 p=0.22 , V = 0.06 V=0.06 ), although OP2/PERMANENT is drawn more often than expected (74 runs against 53).
sents.zh: 就抽取本身而言，每次运行的首次触发条目与在 PERMANENT 和 TRANSIENT 条目上重新归一化后的指定权重一致（391 次运行；蒙特卡洛 p = 0.22 p=0.22 ， V = 0.06 V=0.06 ），尽管 OP2/PERMANENT 被抽取的次数多于预期（74 次对 53 次）。

sents.en: The profile thus fixes what is drawn, while persistence and agent behavior determine how many faults each draw delivers.
sents.zh: 因此，配置档案决定了抽取什么，而持久性和智能体行为决定了每次抽取交付多少故障。

sents.en: Analyses that condition on exposure (zero-dose cells and exposure versus dose, below) use realized doses from the fired-faults log, and the OPP versus OP0 contrasts of Section 6.1 compare conditions as assigned, so neither depends on the per-event mix matching the profile.
sents.zh: 以暴露为条件的分析（下文的零剂量单元以及暴露与剂量对比）使用来自已触发故障日志的实际剂量，而第 6.1 节的 OPP 与 OP0 对比则按分配的条件进行比较，因此两者都不依赖于每事件混合与配置档案的匹配。

paragraphs.en: Of 450 OPP cells, 55 (12.2%) received no fault. Every profile entry targets all tools and every PERMANENT or TRANSIENT draw fires on its first call, so a cell is zero-dose only if the agent made no tool call (29 cells, 17 of them classified as tool bypass) or drew an INTERMITTENT entry that never fired (26 cells, consistent with the 8% INTERMITTENT selection weight; Appendix A ). These cells are distributed across all stacks (LangChain: 21, MCPBench: 15, OpenAI: 19) and are concentrated in tasks where alternative solution paths exist (unit_converter, math_mcp, wikipedia). Including zero-dose cells in the primary analysis dilutes the measured fault effect; excluding them amplifies the degradation from − - 60% to − - 67% in the task completion score.
paragraphs.zh: 在450个OPP单元格中，有55个（12.2%）未接收到故障。 每个profile条目针对所有工具，且每个PERMANENT或TRANSIENT抽取在其首次调用时即触发，因此只有当智能体未进行任何工具调用（29个单元格，其中17个被归类为工具绕过）或抽取了从未触发的INTERMITTENT条目（26个单元格，与8%的INTERMITTENT选择权重一致；附录A）时，单元格才会为零剂量。 这些单元格分布在所有技术栈中（LangChain：21个，MCPBench：15个，OpenAI：19个），并集中在存在替代解决路径的任务中（unit_converter、math_mcp、wikipedia）。 将零剂量单元格纳入主要分析会稀释所测得的故障效应；将其排除后，任务完成分数的退化从− - 60%放大到− - 67%。

sents.en: Of 450 OPP cells, 55 (12.2%) received no fault.
sents.zh: 在450个OPP单元格中，有55个（12.2%）未接收到故障。

sents.en: These cells are distributed across all stacks (LangChain: 21, MCPBench: 15, OpenAI: 19) and are concentrated in tasks where alternative solution paths exist (unit_converter, math_mcp, wikipedia).
sents.zh: 这些单元格分布在所有技术栈中（LangChain：21个，MCPBench：15个，OpenAI：19个），并集中在存在替代解决路径的任务中（unit_converter、math_mcp、wikipedia）。

sents.en: Including zero-dose cells in the primary analysis dilutes the measured fault effect; excluding them amplifies the degradation from − - 60% to − - 67% in the task completion score.
sents.zh: 将零剂量单元格纳入主要分析会稀释所测得的故障效应；将其排除后，任务完成分数的退化从− - 60%放大到− - 67%。

paragraphs.en: Exposure to at least one fault is strongly associated with degradation: OPP cells with one or more fired faults score 2.72 on task completion (OP0: 8.15 for the same cells), against 6.93 for zero-dose cells (OP0: 7.61). The number of faults is not. In a linear mixed-effects model score ∼ \sim fault_dose + stack + (1 | task_id) fit by REML to the 366 completed OPP cells with nonzero dose, the dose coefficient is small and, if anything, positive for all nine metrics (task completion: + 0.06 +0.06 points per fired fault, 95% CI [ − 0.004 , 0.12 ] [-0.004,0.12] ; including zero-dose cells: + 0.01 +0.01 , [ − 0.05 , 0.07 ] [-0.05,0.07] ). Two features of the design explain this. Most runs receive a single PERMANENT draw that fires from the first tool call (see distribution fidelity above), so degradation sets in at first exposure; and dose is confounded with tool-call volume, since agents that keep calling tools, for instance under silent content faults, accumulate more events while still producing partial answers. Zero-dose cells are not a randomized control either: 29 of the 55 made no tool call, and their fault-free scores are lower. We therefore read the evidence as an exposure effect rather than a dose-response relationship.
paragraphs.zh: 暴露于至少一个故障与退化有很强的关联：触发一个或多个故障的 OPP 单元格在任务完成度上得分为 2.72（相同单元格的 OP0 为 8.15），而零剂量单元格为 6.93（OP0 为 7.61）。 故障的数量却并非如此。 在用 REML 拟合于 366 个非零剂量的已完成 OPP 单元格的线性混合效应模型 score ∼ fault_dose + stack + (1 | task_id) 中，剂量系数很小，而且如果有效应的话，对全部九个指标都是正向的（任务完成度：每触发一个故障 + 0.06 分，95% CI [ − 0.004 , 0.12 ]；包含零剂量单元格时：+ 0.01，[ − 0.05 , 0.07 ]）。 实验设计中的两个特点解释了这一点。 大多数运行只会抽取一个从首次工具调用即触发的 PERMANENT 故障（见上文关于分布保真度的内容），因此退化在首次暴露时即出现；而且剂量与工具调用量存在混淆，因为持续调用工具的智能体，例如在静默内容故障下，会积累更多事件，同时仍产生部分答案。 零剂量单元格也不是随机化的对照组：55 个中有 29 个没有进行任何工具调用，而且它们在无故障条件下的得分更低。 因此，我们将这一证据解读为暴露效应，而非剂量-反应关系。

sents.zh: 在用 REML 拟合于 366 个非零剂量的已完成 OPP 单元格的线性混合效应模型 score ∼ fault_dose + stack + (1 | task_id) 中，剂量系数很小，而且如果有效应的话，对全部九个指标都是正向的（任务完成度：每触发一个故障 + 0.06 分，95% CI [ − 0.004 , 0.12 ]；包含零剂量单元格时：+ 0.01，[ − 0.05 , 0.07 ]）。

sents.en: Two features of the design explain this.

sents.zh: 大多数运行只会抽取一个从首次工具调用即触发的 PERMANENT 故障（见上文关于分布保真度的内容），因此退化在首次暴露时即出现；而且剂量与工具调用量存在混淆，因为持续调用工具的智能体，例如在静默内容故障下，会积累更多事件，同时仍产生部分答案。

sents.zh: 因此，我们将这一证据解读为暴露效应，而非剂量-反应关系。

paragraphs.en: Table 4 reports task completion rates for every (model, stack, condition) cell, expanding the headline numbers in Section 6.1 . OP0 rates are 95 to 100% and proxy-off rates 93 to 100% across all (stack, model) cells; the largest OPP drops are for the 120b under MCPBench and OpenAI, although per-stack intervals overlap widely.
paragraphs.zh: 表4报告了每个（模型、技术栈、条件）单元格的任务完成率，扩展了6.1节中的核心数字。 在所有（技术栈、模型）单元格中，OP0的完成率为95%到100%，代理关闭时为93%到100%；OPP下降最大的是120b在MCPBench和OpenAI下的表现，尽管各技术栈的区间重叠很大。

sents.en: Table 4 reports task completion rates for every (model, stack, condition) cell, expanding the headline numbers in Section 6.1 .
sents.zh: 表4报告了每个（模型、技术栈、条件）单元格的任务完成率，扩展了6.1节中的核心数字。

sents.en: OP0 rates are 95 to 100% and proxy-off rates 93 to 100% across all (stack, model) cells; the largest OPP drops are for the 120b under MCPBench and OpenAI, although per-stack intervals overlap widely.
sents.zh: 在所有（技术栈、模型）单元格中，OP0的完成率为95%到100%，代理关闭时为93%到100%；OPP下降最大的是120b在MCPBench和OpenAI下的表现，尽管各技术栈的区间重叠很大。

paragraphs.en: Table 5 reports the full nine-metric degradation summary referenced in Section 6.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 表 5 报告了第 6.1 节中引用的完整九项指标退化总结。

paragraphs.en: Figure 7 shows percentage degradation for each of the 25 tasks across all nine evaluation metrics, pooled across stacks, models, and seeds. Degradation ranges from − - 19% (unit_converter, task completion) to − - 98% (game_trends, grounding). Tasks involving live APIs or deep sequential chains are consistently the most vulnerable, while short-chain computational tasks show the most resilience.
paragraphs.zh: 图 7 展示了在所有九项评估指标下 25 个任务各自的性能退化百分比，并对技术栈、模型和随机种子进行了汇总。 退化幅度从 − -19%（unit_converter，任务完成）到 − -98%（game_trends，事实依据）不等。 涉及实时 API 或深度顺序链的任务始终最为脆弱，而短链计算任务则表现出最强的抗退化能力。

sents.en: Figure 7 shows percentage degradation for each of the 25 tasks across all nine evaluation metrics, pooled across stacks, models, and seeds.
sents.zh: 图 7 展示了在所有九项评估指标下 25 个任务各自的性能退化百分比，并对技术栈、模型和随机种子进行了汇总。

sents.en: Degradation ranges from − - 19% (unit_converter, task completion) to − - 98% (game_trends, grounding).
sents.zh: 退化幅度从 − -19%（unit_converter，任务完成）到 − -98%（game_trends，事实依据）不等。

sents.en: Tasks involving live APIs or deep sequential chains are consistently the most vulnerable, while short-chain computational tasks show the most resilience.
sents.zh: 涉及实时 API 或深度顺序链的任务始终最为脆弱，而短链计算任务则表现出最强的抗退化能力。

paragraphs.en: Restricting to cells that completed under both OP0 and OPP, task completion score drops by 57% (from 8.26 to 3.53), compared to 60% in the primary analysis. The gap between all-in and completed-only is modest (3 percentage points), indicating that non-completion, while present, is not the dominant driver of score degradation; quality loss among completed runs accounts for most of the effect.
paragraphs.zh: 将范围限定为在 OP0 和 OPP 下都完成运行的单元格后，任务完成得分下降 57%（从 8.26 降至 3.53），而主分析中的降幅为 60%。 全量样本与仅完成样本之间的差距很小（3 个百分点），这表明未完成虽然存在，但并非得分退化的主导因素；已完成运行中的质量损失占了该效应的大部分。

sents.en: Restricting to cells that completed under both OP0 and OPP, task completion score drops by 57% (from 8.26 to 3.53), compared to 60% in the primary analysis.
sents.zh: 将范围限定为在 OP0 和 OPP 下都完成运行的单元格后，任务完成得分下降 57%（从 8.26 降至 3.53），而主分析中的降幅为 60%。

sents.en: The gap between all-in and completed-only is modest (3 percentage points), indicating that non-completion, while present, is not the dominant driver of score degradation; quality loss among completed runs accounts for most of the effect.

paragraphs.en: We present detailed case studies for all six failure categories in Appendix E , with representative reasoning traces illustrating how agents cope with injected faults.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在附录 E 中对所有六类失败提供了详细的案例研究，并附上具有代表性的推理轨迹，展示智能体如何应对注入的故障。

paragraphs.en: To ground the failure mode taxonomy (Section 6.1 ), we present annotated case studies for each of the six categories. All examples are drawn from the langchain/120b condition under OPP (seed 1), which exhibits the widest behavioral diversity. Scores are reported on the 0 to 10 scale; “nan” indicates system failure (non-completion).
paragraphs.zh: 为了给故障模式分类法（第6.1节）提供依据，我们针对六个类别逐一给出带注释的案例研究。 所有示例均取自 OPP 条件下的 langchain/120b（种子 1），该组表现出最广泛的行为多样性。 分数采用 0 到 10 的量表报告；“nan”表示系统故障（未完成）。

sents.en: To ground the failure mode taxonomy (Section 6.1 ), we present annotated case studies for each of the six categories.
sents.zh: 为了给故障模式分类法（第6.1节）提供依据，我们针对六个类别逐一给出带注释的案例研究。

sents.en: All examples are drawn from the langchain/120b condition under OPP (seed 1), which exhibits the widest behavioral diversity.
sents.zh: 所有示例均取自 OPP 条件下的 langchain/120b（种子 1），该组表现出最广泛的行为多样性。

sents.en: Scores are reported on the 0 to 10 scale; “nan” indicates system failure (non-completion).
sents.zh: 分数采用 0 到 10 的量表报告；“nan”表示系统故障（未完成）。

paragraphs.en: car_price_evaluator_000 and metropolitan_museum_000 both failed outright, producing no scorable output (all metrics nan). In both cases, the agent encountered persistent access-denied errors and exhausted its turn budget retrying. The reasoning trace for car_price_evaluator_000 reveals repeated attempts with minor parameter variations: “ Since previous attempts denied access, maybe still can try? We have only three tools all denied previously. Might be permission issue; perhaps we cannot get data. Could stop. ” The agent recognized the futility of retrying but continued anyway, a pattern consistent with the absence of explicit fault-type diagnosis noted in Appendix G .
paragraphs.zh: car_price_evaluator_000 和 metropolitan_museum_000 均彻底失败，未产生可评分的输出（所有指标均为 nan）。 在这两个案例中，智能体均遭遇持续的拒绝访问错误，并在重试中耗尽了其回合预算。 car_price_evaluator_000 的推理轨迹显示其反复尝试且仅做微小的参数变动：“既然之前的尝试被拒绝访问，也许仍然可以试试？ 我们只有三个工具，之前都被拒绝了。 可能是权限问题；也许我们无法获取数据。 可以停下了。”该智能体意识到重试是徒劳的，却仍然继续，这一模式与附录 G 中指出的缺乏显式故障类型诊断的情况相符。
